VBVR-Pro：可扩展且可验证的套件VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for
原生视觉推理Native Visual Reasoning

Junxiang Xu Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Ruisi Wang Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Fanyi Pu Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Maijunxian Wang Affiliation: University of California, Berkeley    Ran Ji Affiliation: University of California, San Diego    Tongxi Zhou Affiliation: VBVR Community Contributors    Chenyang Gu Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Jing Zuo Affiliation: VBVR Community Contributors    Hongcan Xiao Affiliation: VBVR Community Contributors    Yimeng Geng Affiliation: VBVR Community Contributors    Wanqi Yin Affiliation: The University of Tokyo    Wei Chen Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Oscar Qian Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Zhengan Yan Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Ziqi Huang Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Haiwen Diao Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Liang Pan Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Bo Li Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Xiangyu Fan Affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong    Dezhi Luo Affiliation: University of Michigan    Fengyuan Yu Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Zehong Zhao Affiliation: University of California, San Diego    Qingying Gao Affiliation: Johns Hopkins University    Tinghui Zhu Affiliation: University of California, Davis    Yilan Zhang Affiliation: University of California, Los Angeles    Jingqi Tong Affiliation: Carnegie Mellon University    Pinyuan Feng Affiliation: Columbia University    Zhengze Jiang Affiliation: Columbia University    Letian Wang Affiliation: University of Toronto    Ziyu Guo Affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong    Renrui Zhang Affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong    Jieneng Chen Affiliation: Stanford University    Sonia Joseph Affiliation: Mila - Institut québécois d’IA    Constantin Venhoff Affiliation: University of Oxford    Saman Motamed Affiliation: INSAIT, Sofia University ‘St. Kliment Ohridski’    Mengyue Yang Affiliation: University of Bristol    Chandra Sripada Affiliation: University of Michigan    Alan Yuille Affiliation: Johns Hopkins University    Philip Torr Affiliation: University of Oxford    Lvmin Zhang Affiliation: Stanford University    Vikash Kumar Affiliation: Carnegie Mellon University    Daniel Khashabi Affiliation: Johns Hopkins University    Nikolaus Kriegeskorte Affiliation: Columbia University    Raphaël Millière Affiliation: University of Oxford    Vincent C. Müller Affiliation: Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen    Anyi Rao Affiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology    Quan Wang Affiliation: VBVR Community Contributors    Ziwei Liu Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University    Dahua Lin Affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong    Lei Yang Affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong    Hokin Deng Affiliation: Carnegie Mellon University Correspondence to: hokind@andrew.cmu.edu    Zhongang Cai Affiliation: Nanyang Technological University Correspondence to: caiz0023@e.ntu.edu.sg
摘要Abstract

原生视觉推理将视觉生成视为推理本身的媒介：视觉状态（Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (\即\ie图像和视频）不仅仅是要理解的输入或要呈现的输出，而且是解决语言之外的问题的一流基础。然而，由于缺乏可扩展的训练任务、可靠的反馈和跨生成基质的受控比较，进展仍然受到瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们介绍images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduceVBVR-Pro，一个闭环测试台，通过生成使本机视觉推理可训练、可验证、可优化且可通过实验控制。, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning through generation trainable, verifiable, optimizable, and experimentally controllable.1）任务扩展。1) Task scaling.VBVR-Pro 将视觉推理转变为受控任务空间VBVR-Pro turns visual reasoning into a controlled task space of300程序生成的任务。在 VBVR-Pro 上训练的模型显示出超出建议套件的强大迁移能力procedurally generated tasks. Models trained on VBVR-Pro show strong transfer beyond the proposed suite across七seven外部视觉推理基准测试，例如 RISE-Video、MME-CoF-Pro 和 BabyVision。进一步的分析证实这些收益反映了视觉推理而不是指令模式拟合。external visual reasoning benchmarks such as RISE-Video, MME-CoF-Pro, and BabyVision. Further analysis validates that these gains reflect visual reasoning rather than instruction-pattern fitting.2）可验证的奖励。2) Verifiable rewards.VBVR-Pro 为基于任务的评估提供可验证的奖励评分器。通过对作为法官的领先 MLLM 进行系统研究，我们确定了常见的常见故障模式VBVR-Pro provides verifiable reward scorers for task-grounded evaluation. Through a systematic study of leading MLLMs as judges, we identify recurring failure modes of the prevalentVLM 作为法官VLM-as-a-judge范式。相比之下，所提出的评分器基于确定性的、特定于任务的规则，实现与人类判断的细粒度一致。重要的是，它们可以作为大规模多任务强化学习的可靠奖励信号，并在视觉推理任务中表现出更强的强化学习后性能。paradigm. In contrast, the proposed scorers are grounded in deterministic, task-specific rules, achieve fine-grained alignment with human judgments. Importantly, they serve as reliable reward signals for large-scale multi-task reinforcement learning and demonstrate stronger post-RL performance across visual reasoning tasks.3）机理研究。3) Mechanism study.VBVR-Pro 支持跨多个领域的受控模态研究VBVR-Pro enables controlled modality studies across more than30图像、视频和交错生成器。我们的分析表明，视频生成对于需要持续时空状态跟踪的任务来说仍然是最强的，而交错生成通过外部化中间视觉状态提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。至关重要的是，消融和探索表明视觉本机轨迹的存在，对于视觉推理来说，这是比明确的语言思想链更重要的基础。我们发布所有数据、模型、评分器和代码，以促进未来的研究。image, video, and interleaved generators. Our analysis shows that video generation remains strongest for tasks requiring persistent spatiotemporal state tracking, while interleaved generation provides a compute-efficient alternative by externalizing intermediate visual states. Critically, ablations and probing suggest the presence of vision-native trajectories that are a more crucial substrate than explicit linguistic chains of thought for visual reasoning. We release all data, models, scorers, and code to facilitate future research.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型的成功使语言成为研究机器推理的主要基础。然而，物理世界中的许多形式的智能并不是天然的语言：它们涉及空间变换、时间连续性、对象持久性和动态交互。最近的研究表明，这种推理可能会通过世代传播得到更好的揭示The success of large language models has made language the dominant substrate for studying machine reasoning. Yet many forms of intelligence in the physical world are not naturally linguistic: they involve spatial transformations, temporal continuity, object persistence, and dynamic interactions. Recent studies suggest that such reasoning may be better exposed through generation(He et al., 2025b; Wang et al., 2026c), 激发新范式, motivating a new paradigm of原生视觉推理native visual reasoning：模型通过构建、更新和优化视觉状态来解决问题（: models solve problems by constructing, updating, and optimizing visual states (\例如\eg、图像和视频），其中视觉状态充当, images and videos), where visual states serve as头等舱first-class推理的基础，而不仅仅是基于语言的推理器的输入或最终呈现的输出。 尽管人们的兴趣日益浓厚，但在现阶段，原生视觉推理仍然难以系统地研究：目前尚不清楚通过生成进行的视觉推理是否可以大规模训练、可靠评估、通过奖励反馈进行优化​​，或者在不同的生成基质之间进行比较。 我们认为，进步需要一个闭环套件：任务必须按程序生成，输出必须可验证地评分，模型必须通过可靠的奖励进行优化，并且模态选择必须在受控条件下进行测试。 在这项工作中，我们引入 VBVR-Pro 作为基础设施，使本机视觉推理通过生成可训练、可验证、可优化和实验可控。substrates for reasoning, rather than merely inputs to a language-based reasoner or final rendered outputs. Despite growing interest, native visual reasoning remains difficult to study systematically at the current stage: it remains unclear whether visual reasoning through generation can be trained at scale, reliably evaluated, optimized with reward feedback, or compared across different generative substrates. We argue that progress requires a closed-loop suite: tasks must be procedurally generated, outputs must be verifiably scored, models must be optimized with reliable rewards, and modality choices must be tested under controlled conditions. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro as the infrastructure that makes native visual reasoning through generation trainable, verifiable, optimizable, and experimentally controllable.

首先，本机视觉推理缺乏可扩展和可训练的任务源。现有的基准涵盖不同的功能，但主要是为了评估而设计的，并且通常提供很少或根本不提供训练数据。相反，现有的大规模合成来源First, native visual reasoning lacks scalable and trainable task sources. Existing benchmarks cover diverse capabilities but are primarily designed for evaluation and often provide little or no training data. Conversely, existing large-scale synthetic sources(Wang et al., 2026a)倾向于关注简化的符号设置，对于是否教授可转移的视觉推理技能持开放态度。 VBVR-Pro 将生成过程中的视觉推理转变为受控任务空间。每个任务都作为具有随机参数的程序生成器来实现。重要的是，同时生成多个对齐模态，包括视频、关键帧图像和交错文本注释，以便能够在从相同底层任务分布训练的图像生成器、视频生成器和交错生成器之间进行更公平的比较。还记录了可​​验证评估所需的元数据。 这会产生 300 个任务，并且生成的训练数据显示出超出提议套件的强大可移植性。在我们的能力转移研究中，跨图像、视频和交错视觉推理器，在 VBVR-Pro 上训练的模型在各种保留的视觉推理基准（包括 RISE-Video）中获得了一致的增益（通常超过 20 个百分点）tend to focus on simplified symbolic settings, leaving open whether they teach transferable visual reasoning skills. VBVR-Pro turns visual reasoning through generation into a controlled task space. Each task is implemented as a procedural generator with randomized parameters. Importantly, multiple aligned modalities, including videos, keyframe images, and interleaved textual annotations, are generated simultaneously to enable fairer comparison among image generators, video generators, and interleaved generators trained from the same underlying task distribution. Metadata needed for verifiable evaluation are also recorded. This yields 300 tasks and the resulting training data demonstrates strong transferability beyond the proposed suite. In our capability transfer study, across image, video, and interleaved visual reasoners, models trained on VBVR-Pro obtain consistent gains (often more than 20 percentage points) across a wide range of held-out visual reasoning benchmarks, including RISE-Video(Zhao et al., 2026b), V-ReasonBench (Luo et al., 2025b), 标尺-工作台, RULER-Bench(He et al., 2025a), MME-CoF-Pro (Qi et al., 2026), 视频ThinkBench, VideoThinkBench(Tong et al., 2026), 宝宝视觉, BabyVision(Chen et al., 2026b)、和智能VBench, and IntelligentVBench(Pan et al., 2026)。 这表明视觉推理机制的广泛覆盖对于迁移来说比简单地增加较小任务集中的实例数量更重要。 然而，一个核心问题是，这种收益是否反映了真正的视觉推理，或者仅仅是来自更大的合成数据的指令模式拟合。因此，我们进行了一系列诊断分析。 (1) 视觉和文本嵌入空间中的最近邻分析表明，保留的基准案例不能通过与训练样本的紧密匹配来解释。 (2) 相同提示的视觉反事实表明，即使指令保持固定，在 VBVR-Pro 上训练的模型也能正确响应视觉状态的变化。 (3) 模型展示了视觉推理行为（. This shows that broad coverage of visual reasoning mechanisms is more important for transfer than simply increasing the number of instances from a narrower set of tasks. A central concern, however, is whether such gains reflect genuine visual reasoning or merely instruction-pattern fitting from larger synthetic data. We therefore conduct a suite of diagnostic analyses. (1) nearest-neighbor analyses in visual and textual embedding spaces show that held-out benchmark cases are not explained by close matches to training samples. (2) same-prompt visual counterfactuals reveal that models trained on VBVR-Pro respond correctly to changes in visual states even when the instruction remains fixed. (3) the model demonstrates visual reasoning behaviors (\例如\eg，多路径探索, multi-path exploration(Wang et al., 2026c)）表明迁移增益来自于学习可重用的视觉推理操作，而不是拟合肤浅的指令模板。总之，这些诊断表明 VBVR-Pro 提供了可扩展的课程，而不仅仅是扩大的任务集合。) that suggest that the transfer gains arise from learning reusable visual reasoning operations rather than fitting superficial instruction templates. Together, these diagnostics suggest that VBVR-Pro provides a scalable curriculum rather than merely an enlarged task collection.

其次，本机视觉推理需要可靠的反馈。流行的Second, native visual reasoning requires reliable feedback. The prevalentVLM 作为法官VLM-as-a-judge范式对于开放式输出很有吸引力，但对于视觉推理来说通常不可靠，其中正确性取决于精确计数、细粒度空间关系、时间一致性和规则满足。 我们系统地分析领先的 MLLM（paradigm is attractive for open-ended outputs but is often unreliable for visual reasoning, where correctness depends on exact counts, fine-grained spatial relations, temporal consistency, and rule satisfaction. We systematically analyze leading MLLMs (\例如\eg, GPT-5.5 (OpenAI, 2026b), Qwen-3.7-plus (Qwen Team, 2026b)、Gemini-3.1-Pro, and Gemini-3.1-Pro(Deepmind, 2026)）作为法官并识别反复出现的故障模式，包括数值不精确、忽视细粒度证据以及对任务规则的误解。 为了解决这个问题，VBVR-Pro 将评估任务与基于结构化语义提取和基于任务的验证的可验证奖励评分器配对。与之前基于聚合排名相关性的模型级验证不同，我们通过竞技场式的人类研究来评估实例级别的奖励质量。在这个更严格的协议下，我们的评分员与人类判断达成了高度一致，并且在每个实例的准确性方面远远优于基于 VLM 的判断员。 至关重要的是，这些评分器可以实现优化，而不仅仅是评估：它们提供基于任务的明确且有方向意义的学习信号。实验表明，即使在强大的基线上，使用它们作为奖励也会产生稳定的改进，这表明可验证的奖励可以作为大规模视觉推理中多任务强化学习的实用基础。) as judges and identify recurring failure modes, including numerical imprecision, neglect of fine-grained evidence, and misunderstanding of task rules. To address this, VBVR-Pro pairs evaluated tasks with verifiable reward scorers based on structured semantic extraction and task-grounded verification. Unlike prior model-level validation based on aggregate rank correlations, we evaluate reward quality at the instance level through an arena-style human study. Under this stricter protocol, our scorers achieve strong agreement with human judgments and substantially outperform VLM-based judges in per-instance accuracy. Crucially, these scorers enable optimization rather than evaluation alone: they offer task-grounded and learning signals that are unambiguous and directionally meaningful. Experiments show that using them as rewards yields steady improvements even on strong baselines, demonstrating that verifiable rewards can serve as a practical foundation for multi-task reinforcement learning in large-scale visual reasoning.

第三，目前还不清楚哪种生成基质最能支持视觉推理。视频生成提供连续的时间轨迹，图像生成提供压缩单一视觉输出的效率，交错生成提供集成的视觉文本推理Third, it remains unclear which generative substrate best supports visual reasoning. Video generation offers continuous temporal trajectories, image generation offers efficiency in condensed single visual output, and interleaved generation offers integrated visual-textual reasoning(Gu et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025a)。然而，这些范例很少在共享任务分配和验证协议下进行训练和评估。 借助相同的任务套件和记分器，VBVR-Pro 可以对 30 多个图像、视频和交错生成器、不同的比例、输出格式和模态配置进行受控比较。 我们的结果表明，视频生成对于需要持续时空状态跟踪的任务来说仍然是最强的，而交错生成通过外部化中间视觉状态提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。相反，仅图像生成通常缺乏表达程序或时间推理的能力。 此外，与消除视觉状态相比，在交错模型中降低语言推理的效果有限. However, these paradigms have rarely been trained and evaluated under a shared task distribution and verification protocol. With the same task suite and scorers, VBVR-Pro enables controlled comparison across more than 30 image, video, and interleaved generators, varying scale, output format, and modality configuration. Our results show that video generation remains strongest for tasks requiring persistent spatiotemporal state tracking, while interleaved generation offers a compute-efficient alternative by externalizing intermediate visual states. In contrast, image-only generation often lacks the capacity to express procedural or temporal reasoning. Moreover, degrading language reasoning in interleaved models has limited effect compared with removing visual states(Xu et al., 2026)。进一步的中间状态干预实验表明，模型有因果关系地使用了中间视觉状态：破坏或替换它们可以预见地降低或重定向最终答案。这些结果表明，视觉轨迹，而不是明确的语言思想链，构成了本机视觉推理的关键基础。. Further middle-state intervention experiments show that intermediate visual states are causally used by the model: corrupting or replacing them can predictably degrade or redirect the final answer. These results suggest that visual trajectories, rather than explicit linguistic chains of thought, form a critical substrate for native visual reasoning.

总之，VBVR-Pro 为通过生成扩展本机视觉推理奠定了闭环基础。它提供：1）程序生成的视觉推理环境的可扩展课程； 2）可验证的奖励评分器，与人类一致并可用于强化学习； 3）模态控制的模型套件，涵盖图像、视频和交错生成器，具有诊断证据，可验证视觉状态推理。这些组件共同使得原生视觉推理可训练、可验证、可优化且可通过实验控制。In summary, VBVR-Pro establishes a closed-loop foundation for scaling native visual reasoning through generation. It provides: 1) a scalable curriculum of procedurally generated visual reasoning environments; 2) verifiable reward scorers that are human-aligned and usable for reinforcement learning; 3) a modality-controlled model suite spanning image, video, and interleaved generators, with diagnostic evidence, validating visual-state reasoning. Together, these components make native visual reasoning trainable, verifiable, optimizable, and experimentally controllable.

2 VBVR-Pro-Dataset：任务扩展以实现可转移性VBVR-Pro-Dataset: Task Scaling for Transferability

视觉推理的一个核心挑战是缺乏大规模、多样化的训练数据，这些数据的传输超出了训练过程中看到的模式。之前的工作A central challenge in visual reasoning is the scarcity of large-scale, diverse training data that transfers beyond the patterns seen during training. Prior work(Wang et al., 2026a)已经表明，大规模综合监督可以改善视频推理，但其向更广泛的下游视觉推理基准的转移仍然有限。我们假设一个重要的瓶颈是任务覆盖范围，而不仅仅是实例计数：从一组固定的任务生成器中重复采样会产生类似推理模式的许多变化，但不会实质性地扩展正在训练的能力范围。 受这一观察的启发，我们构建了 VBVR-Pro-Dataset，这是一个大型合成数据集，包含 300 个任务，涵盖不同的视觉环境和推理能力（has shown that large-scale synthetic supervision can improve video reasoning, but its transfer to broader downstream visual reasoning benchmarks remains limited. We hypothesize that an important bottleneck is task coverage rather than instance count alone: repeatedly sampling from a fixed set of task generators creates many variations of similar reasoning patterns, but does not substantially expand the range of capabilities being trained. Motivated by this observation, we construct VBVR-Pro-Dataset, a large-scale synthetic dataset with 300 tasks spanning diverse visual environments and reasoning capabilities (Section 2.1）。 然后我们描述用于构建 VBVR-Pro 的实现和管理协议（). We then describe the implementation and curation protocol used to build VBVR-Pro (Section 2.2）。 最后，我们根据现有的视觉推理资源分析 VBVR-Pro，强调其规模、模态覆盖范围和任务多样性（). Finally, we analyze VBVR-Pro against existing visual reasoning resources, highlighting its scale, modality coverage, and task diversity (Section 2.3).

2.1 任务设计Task Design

VBVR-Pro 是通过全球 50 多名研究人员和工程师的大规模协作努力构建的。我们的目的不是列举孤立的任务，而是寻求构建一个广泛的、可训练的任务空间，涵盖社区实际感兴趣的视觉推理能力。VBVR-Pro is built through a large-scale collaborative effort involving more than 50 researchers and engineers worldwide. Rather than aiming to enumerate isolated tasks, we seek to construct a broad and trainable task space that covers visual reasoning capabilities of practical interest to the community.

分类学。Taxonomy.

我们采用VBVR的认知框架We adapt the cognitive framework of VBVR(Wang et al., 2026a)，它将视觉推理分为五个功能：, which organizes visual reasoning into five faculties:知觉perception, 空间性spatiality, 转变transformation, 抽象abstraction, 和, and知识knowledge. 感知Perception直接从视觉输入中提取信息，涵盖 OCR、符号识别、计数、排序和视觉比较。extracts information directly from visual inputs, covering OCR, symbol recognition, counting, sorting, and visual comparison.空间性Spatiality有关位置和几何关系的原因，包括相对位置、3D 结构和导航。reasons about locations and geometric relationships, including relative positions, 3D structures, and navigation.转型Transformation通过 2D 平移和旋转等操作来操纵视觉表示。manipulates visual representations through operations such as 2D translation and rotation.抽象Abstraction从观察中推断类别或规则，包括模式归纳、对称性和形状完成，以及复杂或新指定规则下的推理。最后，infers categories or rules from observations, including pattern induction, symmetry and shape completion, and reasoning under complex or newly specified rules. Finally,知识knowledge借鉴内在或获得的知识，例如传统的图标含义、物理现象、常识、经典游戏的规则和策略以及日常物体的机制。 认识到综合任务可以展示多种功能，VBVR-Pro 中的任务可以带有多个标签。draws on intrinsic or acquired knowledge, such as conventional icon meanings, physical phenomena, common sense, rules and strategies of classic games, and the mechanics of everyday objects. Recognizing that a comprehensive task could demonstrate multiple capabilities, tasks in VBVR-Pro can carry several labels.

设计原则。Design Principles.

每个任务都是根据四个原则设计的。首先，核心推理过程应该是视觉原生的：解决方案应该依赖于视觉状态转换、空间关系或动力学，而不是纯粹的语言演绎。二是任务成果明确、可严格检查；通过人工检查模型响应来迭代地完善提示和视觉输入。第三，任务应该通过随机的外观、布局、对象属性、场景配置和释义的文本提示来展现大量的视觉多样性。第四，鼓励贡献者设计需要多步推理而不是单步感知或模式匹配的重要任务。Each task is designed according to four principles. First, the core reasoning process should be vision-native: the solution should depend on visual state transformations, spatial relations, or dynamics rather than purely linguistic deduction. Second, task outcomes should be unambiguous and rigorously inspectable; prompts and visual inputs are iteratively refined through human inspection of model responses. Third, tasks should exhibit substantial visual diversity through randomized appearances, layouts, object attributes, scene configurations, and paraphrased textual prompts. Fourth, contributors are encouraged to design non-trivial tasks that require multi-step reasoning rather than single-step perception or pattern matching.

2.2 实施Implementation

发电机。Generators.

VBVR-Pro 由统一框架下的 300 个任务特定生成器构建而成：其中 150 个是从 VBVR 重新实现和修改的VBVR-Pro is built from 300 task-specific generators under a unified framework: 150 are reimplemented and revised from VBVR(Wang et al., 2026a)，并新设计了 150 个以扩大任务覆盖范围。每个生成器都是一个参数化程序，它从结构化参数空间中采样配置，例如网格大小、对象计数、布局、视觉外观和难度级别，然后实例化相应的问题实例。特定于任务的求解器计算正确的解决方案，提供以编程方式导出的监督，无需手动注释。, and 150 are newly designed to broaden task coverage. Each generator is a parameterized program that samples a configuration from a structured parameter space, such as grid size, object count, layout, visual appearance, and difficulty level, and then instantiates a corresponding problem instance. A task-specific solver computes the correct solution, providing programmatically derived supervision without manual annotation.

元数据。Metadata.

在生成过程中，每个已解决的实例都附有一个元数据文件，其中包含其随机种子、问题规范、完整解决方案和关键元素属性。此信息为中引入的可验证奖励评分者提供了结构化的基本事实During generation, each solved instance is accompanied by a metadata file containing its random seed, problem specification, complete solution, and key element attributes. This information provides structured ground truth for the verifiable reward scorers introduced inSection 3。它还用于重复数据删除和拆分构建，确保训练和评估实例之间的明确分离。. It is also used for de-duplication and split construction, ensuring a clear separation between training and evaluation instances.

多模态。Multi-modality.

VBVR-Pro 的一个关键功能是每个实例都被渲染为对齐的视觉模式，包括视频和图像。构建图像模态需要的不仅仅是从视频中采样帧：不同的任务需要不同级别的轨迹信息才能保持答案完整。 如图所示A key feature of VBVR-Pro is that each instance is rendered into aligned visual modalities, including video and image. Constructing the image modality requires more than simply sampling frames from the video: different tasks require different levels of trajectory information for the answer to remain complete. As illustrated inFigure 3，图像模态采用三种输出机制。, the image modality adopts three output regimes.最后一帧Last-Frame仅显示其解决方案可由单个图像表示的任务的最终状态，例如选择正确的选项。shows only the final state for tasks whose solutions can be represented by a single image, such as selecting the correct option.关键帧Key-Frame呈现捕获求解过程中基本转变的选定状态。对于迷宫导航等基于路径的任务，完整的解决方案轨迹另外绘制在选定的帧上。presents selected states that capture the essential transitions in the solution process. For path-based tasks such as maze navigation, the complete solution trajectory is additionally drawn on the selected frames.多帧Multi-Frame对评估流程完整性、有效性或时间连续性的任务的中间状态进行统一采样。 这些机制共同保留了视频的基本解决方案信息，同时提供紧凑的基于图像的表示。我们强调，视频和图像不是单独的语料库，而是同一潜在问题的不同呈现，具有等效的解决方案。这种设计可以在相同的任务条件下实现视频和图像生成之间的受控比较。 进一步的设计细节和示例提供于uniformly samples intermediate states for tasks that evaluate process integrity, validity, or temporal continuity. Together, these regimes preserve the essential solution information of the video while providing compact image-based representations. We emphasize that videos and images are not separate corpora, but different renderings of the same underlying problem with equivalent solutions. This design enables controlled comparison between video and image generation under identical task conditions. Further design details and examples are provided inSection C.1.

策展。Curation.

由于配置是按程序采样的，因此每个生成器都可以生成大量不同的实例。为了确保可靠性，我们通过检查渲染样本并验证其求解器实现来审查所有 300 个生成器。我们还会在发布前检查每个任务的分辨率、帧速率和帧数。对于交错设置，我们另外使用 Gemini-3.1-Pro-PreviewSince configurations are sampled procedurally, each generator can produce a large number of diverse instances. To ensure reliability, we review all 300 generators by inspecting rendered samples and verifying their solver implementations. We also check the resolution, frame rate, and frame count of every task before release. For the interleaved setting, we additionally use Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview(Deepmind, 2026)生成中间解决方案步骤的文本描述。我们为每个任务设计一个专用提示，并将其统一应用于该任务的所有实例。更多详细信息请参见to generate textual descriptions of intermediate solution steps. We design a dedicated prompt for each task and apply it uniformly to all instances from that task. Further details are provided inSection C.2.

2.3 统计与分析Statistics and Analysis

Table 1将 VBVR-Pro 与现有视觉推理基准和数据集在任务覆盖范围、数据集规模、支持的模式和评估协议方面进行比较。在 300 个任务中，我们保留了 50 个任务进行域外评估，每个任务采样 5,000 个实例 从剩余的 250 个任务中提取，产生 125 万个训练实例。 VBVR-Pro-Bench 包含 50 个域外任务和 250 个任务中的另外 50 个任务，训练数据为域内任务（总共 100 个任务）。此外，VBVR-Pro还包含用于强化学习的专用训练集，涵盖了50个域内任务，用于实验中compares VBVR-Pro with existing visual reasoning benchmarks and datasets in terms of task coverage, dataset scale, supported modalities, and evaluation protocols. Amongst 300 tasks, we hold out 50 tasks for out-of-domain evaluation, and sample 5,000 instances per task from the remaining 250 tasks, resulting in 1.25M training instances. VBVR-Pro-Bench contains the 50 out-of-domain tasks and another 50 tasks from the 250 tasks with training data as in-domain tasks (total 100 tasks). In addition, VBVR-Pro includes a dedicated training set for reinforcement learning that covers the 50 in-domain tasks, which is used in the experiments inSection 5。在比较的资源中，VBVR-Pro 提供了最大的训练集，并且在统一的任务分配下独特地支持视频、图像和交错模式。. Among the compared resources, VBVR-Pro provides the largest training set and uniquely supports video, image, and interleaved modalities under a unified task distribution.

Figure 2显示 VBVR-Pro 中的代表性任务，根据相应的认知能力进行着色。每个教师都跨越广泛的视觉环境，从空白画布上的图元到结构化的游戏状态、棋盘配置和基于精灵的场景。 与改编自VBVR的150个重新设计的任务相比，这150个新开发的任务旨在提供更广泛、更具挑战性的视觉推理场景覆盖。我们从两个维度分析这种扩张。 首先，就视觉复杂性而言，平均每个任务超过 50 个采样问题帧，新任务中位数包含 80 个不同的连接颜色区域，而修改后的任务包含 12 个不同的连接颜色区域。其他指标，例如空间信息和编码图像大小，也表现出相同的趋势（shows representative tasks from VBVR-Pro, colored according to their corresponding cognitive faculties. Each faculty spans a wide range of visual environments, from primitives on blank canvases to structured game states, board configurations, and sprite-based scenes. Compared with the 150 reworked tasks adapted from VBVR, the 150 newly developed tasks are designed to provide broader and more challenging coverage of visual reasoning scenarios. We analyze this expansion along two dimensions. First, in terms of visual complexity, averaged over 50 sampled question frames per task, the median new task contains 80 distinct connected color regions, compared with 12 for the reworked tasks. Other metrics, such as spatial information and encoded image size, exhibit the same trend (Section C.3）。 其次，就推理深度而言，重新设计的任务通常可以通过对输入应用单个规则来解决，而许多新任务，例如数独和五子棋，需要对候选解决方案或动作进行多步搜索。在盲法成对比较中，150 对中的 113 对被认为新任务需要更深入的推理。此外，只有 7% 的重新设计的 VBVR 任务需要多步推理，而新任务的这一比例为 47%（). Second, in terms of reasoning depth, the reworked tasks are often solvable by applying a single rule to the input, whereas many new tasks, such as Sudoku and Gomoku, require multi-step search over candidate solutions or actions. In a blinded pairwise comparison, the new task was judged to require deeper reasoning in 113 of the 150 pairs. Moreover, only 7% of the reworked VBVR tasks require multi-step reasoning, compared with 47% of the new tasks (Section C.4）。 如图所示). As shown inSection 4.4，VBVR-Pro-Dataset 上的训练因此可以在下游视觉推理基准上产生更强、更一致的性能。, training on VBVR-Pro-Dataset consequently yields stronger and more consistent performance on downstream visual reasoning benchmarks.

3 可验证的奖励计分者Verifiable Reward Scorers

值得信赖的基准测试需要准确、廉价且可重复的评估器。主流A trustworthy benchmark requires evaluators that are accurate, inexpensive, and reproducible. The mainstreamVLM 作为法官VLM-as-a-judge范式常常无法满足这些要求，特别是对于需要精确验证的视觉推理任务（paradigm often fails to satisfy these requirements, especially for visual reasoning tasks that demand precise verification (Section 3.1）。为了解决这个限制，我们构建了一套). To address this limitation, we build a suite of可验证的奖励评分者verifiable reward scorers对于 VBVR-Pro-Bench 中的所有 100 个任务（50 个域内和 50 个域外）（for all 100 tasks (50 In-Domain and 50 Out-of-Domain) in VBVR-Pro-Bench (Section 3.2）。我们进一步根据大规模人类偏好验证这些评分器（). We further validate these scorers against large-scale human preferences (Section 3.3），表明他们以比基于 VLM 的法官低得多的成本实现了更强的人类一致性。这些特性使评分器不仅成为可靠评估的关键基础，而且也成为视觉推理的大规模多任务强化学习的关键基础，正如), showing that they achieve stronger human alignment at substantially lower cost than VLM-based judges. These properties make the scorers a critical foundation not only for reliable evaluation, but also for large-scale multi-task reinforcement learning for visual reasoning, as studied inSection 5.

3.1 VLM 作为法官的局限性Limitations of VLM-as-a-Judge

VLM-as-a-judge 已成为许多近期视觉推理基准测试的常见评估选择（VLM-as-a-judge has become a common evaluation choice for many recent visual reasoning benchmarks (Table 1）因为它易于部署并且适用于开放式输出。然而，我们发现这种范式在用作强化学习的评估指标或奖励函数时存在问题) because it is easy to deploy and applicable to open-ended outputs. However, we find that this paradigm is problematic when used either as an evaluation metric or as a reward function for reinforcement learning(Liu and Zhang, 2025; Motamed et al., 2025; Motamed et al., 2026).

首先，VLM 的判断可能不准确。插图于First, VLM judges can be inaccurate. Illustrated inFigure 4，我们观察到三种有代表性的失效模式。, we observe three representative failure modes.(一)(a)法官对细粒度的视觉感知可能不精确。例如，在加法混色任务中，生成的球的色调不正确，但所有三个 VLM 评委都给出至少Judges can be imprecise on fine-grained visual perception. For example, in an additive color-mixing task, the generated ball has an incorrect hue, yet all three VLM judges assign scores of at least0.800.80, 与, compared with0.400.40来自我们的得分手。from our scorer.(二)(b)法官可以忽略决定性错误。在同心环任务中，输出改变了应该保留的圆圈大小和颜色，但评委仍然给出高分，例如Judges can overlook decisive errors. In a concentric-ring task, the output changes circle sizes and colors that should be preserved, but the judges still assign high scores, such as0.780.78 or 0.930.93. (三)(c)法官可能会误解任务本身。在模式完成任务中，正确答案会收到Judges can misunderstand the task itself. In a pattern-completion task, a correct answer receives0.940.94来自我们的得分手，但仅from our scorer but only0.240.24–0.800.80来自 VLM 评委。这些例子表明，VLM 法官可能会在两个方向上犯错误：高估不正确的输出和低估正确的输出。from VLM judges. These examples show that VLM judges can make mistakes in both directions: overestimating incorrect outputs and underestimating correct ones.

其次，VLM法官的费用昂贵。这种限制在强化学习中变得尤其严重，因为必须在许多优化步骤中对大量推出进行评分。专有法官会产生大量 API 成本，而开源法官则需要 GPU 推理，以在固定计算预算下与模型训练竞争。相比之下，我们的特定任务评分器是轻量级的，并且每次评估的成本要低得多（Second, VLM judges are expensive. This limitation becomes particularly severe in reinforcement learning, where a large number of rollouts must be scored over many optimization steps. Proprietary judges incur substantial API costs, while open-source judges require GPU inference that competes with model training under a fixed compute budget. In contrast, our task-specific scorers are lightweight and substantially cheaper per evaluation (Figure 6).

第三，VLM 判断的可重复性不可靠。即使在温度下Third, VLM judges are not reliably reproducible. Even at temperature00，对相同视频的重复评估可能会产生不同的分数, repeated evaluations on the same videos can produce different scores for5555–93%93\%样本，而我们的确定性评分器在运行中产生相同的结果（of samples, whereas our deterministic scorer produces identical results across runs (Table 2）。当分数用作每个样本的奖励时，这种可重复性尤其重要：不一致的反馈可能会引入噪音或冲突的优化信号，并阻碍有效的学习。). This reproducibility is especially important when scores are used as per-sample rewards: inconsistent feedback can introduce noisy or conflicting optimization signals and hinder effective learning.

3.2 可验证奖励计分器的设计Design of Verifiable Reward Scorers

我们为 VBVR-Pro-Bench 中的 100 项任务中的每一项实施了专用的可验证奖励评分器。只要有可能，评分者就会避免依赖像素级差异，而是对与任务相关的语义实体进行操作。每个评分器使用经典的计算机视觉方法（包括 HSV 颜色分割、轮廓检测、渲染数字和标签的 OCR 以及跨帧轨迹跟踪）来定位感兴趣的对象并提取其属性，例如颜色、形状、位置和计数。然后对这些提取的属性而不是原始像素进行分级。这种语义设计使分数更具可解释性和鲁棒性：像素级比较可能会由于轻微的空间变化或渲染风格差异而惩罚正确答案，而属性级验证则侧重于与任务相关的正确性。We implement a dedicated verifiable reward scorer for each of the 100 tasks in VBVR-Pro-Bench. Whenever possible, the scorers avoid relying on pixel-level differences and instead operate on task-relevant semantic entities. Each scorer locates the objects of interest and extracts their attributes, such as color, shape, position, and count, using classical computer-vision methods including HSV color segmentation, contour detection, OCR for rendered digits and labels, and trajectory tracking across frames. Grading is then performed over these extracted attributes rather than raw pixels. This semantic design makes the scores more interpretable and robust: a pixel-level comparison may penalize a correct answer due to slight spatial shifts or rendering-style differences, whereas attribute-level verification focuses on task-relevant correctness.

Figure 5说明了两个评估者端到端的情况。给定提取的属性，每个评估者都会使用一系列特定于任务的检查以及人工设计和仔细校准的权重，并将它们汇总为最终分数。对于具有软标准的任务，最终分数计算为加权总和，如下所示illustrates two evaluators end to end. Given the extracted attributes, each evaluator applies a set of task-specific checks with human-designed and carefully calibrated weights, and aggregates them into a final score. For tasks with soft criteria, the final score is computed as a weighted sum, as shown inFigure 5（一）。对于具有硬约束的任务，例如避免穿越墙壁，检查会乘法组合，以便单次违规会急剧降低最终分数，如下所示(a). For tasks with hard constraints, such as avoiding wall crossings, checks are combined multiplicatively so that a single violation sharply reduces the final score, as shown inFigure 5（二）。由于评分器是作为轻量级计算实现的，因此它们不需要 API 调用，仅可选地使用 GPU 计算进行 OCR，并且是完全确定性的。它们还提供可解释的错误分解，指示样本的哪些特定任务检查失败。(b). Because the scorers are implemented as lightweight computations, they require no API calls, use GPU computation only optionally for OCR, and are fully deterministic. They also provide interpretable error decomposition, indicating which task-specific checks a sample fails.

3.3 人类偏好调整Human Preference Alignment

为了评估准确性和效率，我们根据大量人类偏好注释来验证我们的评分器，并将它们与相同评估设置下的多个 VLM 作为评判基线进行比较。 VBVR-Pro-Bench 包含 100 个任务，每个任务有 5 个实例。我们评估了八种视频生成模型，得出To evaluate both accuracy and efficiency, we validate our scorers against a large collection of human preference annotations and compare them with multiple VLM-as-a-judge baselines under the same evaluation setting. VBVR-Pro-Bench contains 100 tasks with five instances per task. We evaluate eight video generation models, yielding4,0004{,}000视频总数。为了评估评估者的可靠性，我们对每个任务采样一个实例，比较所有模型对，并为每对模型收集十个独立的人工注释。注释者使用标准化的评分标准对两个视频的绝对质量进行评分，我们将这些评分转换为成对的偏好，相当于标准的四向竞技场格式。我们将每个自动评估器产生的分数映射到相同的偏好格式，并衡量与人类判断的一致性。我们还根据专有法官的 API 令牌使用情况和使用云服务定价的开源法官的 GPU 运行时间来估计评估成本。完整的注释标准、偏好映射和成本计算在videos in total. To assess evaluator reliability, we sample one instance per task, compare all pairs of models, and collect ten independent human annotations for each pair. Annotators rate the absolute quality of both videos using a standardized rubric, and we convert these ratings into pairwise preferences, equivalent to a standard four-way arena format. We map the scores produced by each automatic evaluator to the same preference format and measure agreement with human judgments. We also estimate evaluation cost based on API token usage for proprietary judges and GPU runtime for open-source judges using cloud-service pricing. Full annotation criteria, preference mappings, and cost calculations are provided inSection D.1.

4 对本机视觉推理进行基准测试Benchmarking Native Visual Reasoning

在本节中，我们在 VBVR-Pro-Bench 上对领先的专有和开源生成模型进行基准测试。我们首先报告整体性能并分析不同生成范式的行为，包括图像、视频和交错生成（In this section, we benchmark leading proprietary and open-source generative models on VBVR-Pro-Bench. We first report overall performance and analyze the behavior of different generative paradigms, including image, video, and interleaved generation (Section 4.1）。然后，我们进行反事实诊断，以检查训练后的模型是否依赖于可重用的推理轨迹，而不是肤浅的捷径（). We then conduct counterfactual diagnostics to examine whether trained models rely on reusable reasoning trajectories rather than superficial shortcuts (Section 4.2）。最后，我们通过步骤链分析可视化本机视觉推理行为（). Finally, we visualize native visual reasoning behaviors through Chain-of-Step analysis (Section 4.3）并评估对各种看不见的基准的可转移性（) and evaluate transferability to a wide range of unseen benchmarks (Section 4.4).

4.1.2 主要结果Main Results

Table 4在 VBVR-Pro-Bench 上比较了 30 多个专有和开源模型。我们发现顶级专有模型，例如 Seedance 2.0 和 GPT-Image-2，取得了强劲的性能，这表明当前的生成模型已经表现出了非凡的视觉推理能力。相比之下，大多数学术开源模型都严重落后，我们认为任务相关训练数据的可用性是一个重要的瓶颈。与这一观察结果一致，VBVR-Pro-Dataset 上的特定任务训练改进了跨图像、交错文本图像和视频生成的所有九个模型，平均总体增益为compares more than 30 proprietary and open-source models on VBVR-Pro-Bench. We find that top-tier proprietary models, such as Seedance 2.0 and GPT-Image-2, achieve strong performance, indicating that current generative models already exhibit nontrivial visual reasoning capabilities. In contrast, most academic open-source models lag substantially behind, for which we believe the availability of task-relevant training data is an important bottleneck. Consistent with this observation, task-specific training on VBVR-Pro-Dataset improves all nine models across image, interleaved text-image, and video generation, with an average overall gain of0.2900.290。然而，即使是最强大的训练模型仍然远低于人类水平，这凸显了巨大的改进空间。. Nevertheless, even the strongest trained model remains well below human-level performance, highlighting the considerable room for improvement.

为了区分任务内泛化和跨任务转移，我们在域内（ID）和域外（OOD）设置下评估模型。 ID 评估使用来自相同任务分布的未见实例作为训练并测量已知任务族内的泛化，而 OOD 评估引入不同的任务分布并测量学习的视觉推理能力是否转移到未见的任务。训练在 ID 任务上取得了显着的进步，平均提高了To distinguish within-task generalization from cross-task transfer, we evaluate models under both in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) settings. ID evaluation uses unseen instances from the same task distributions as training and measures generalization within known task families, whereas OOD evaluation introduces different task distributions and measures whether learned visual reasoning capabilities transfer to unseen tasks. Training yields pronounced gains on ID tasks, with an average improvement of+0.401+0.401，而 OOD 性能也持续提高，平均增益为, while OOD performance also improves consistently, with an average gain of+0.179+0.179。这证明 VBVR-Pro-Dataset 不仅改进了已知任务中的实例级泛化，而且还改进了跨任务族的迁移。我们进一步研究了外部推理基准的可转移性，包括现实世界和具体场景，. This provides evidence that VBVR-Pro-Dataset improves not only instance-level generalization within known tasks, but also transfer across task families. We further examine transferability to external reasoning benchmarks, including real-world and embodied scenarios, inSection 4.4.

4.1.3 图像、交错文本图像和视频生成Image, Interleaved Text-Image, and Video Generation

普遍的直觉是视频生成应该优于交错文本图像生成，因为视频提供密集的时间连续性。然而，经过特定任务的训练后，我们发现最强的交错文本图像模型 VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1 在许多 ID 任务中的表现与最强的视频模型 VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 相当。这表明，一旦学习了底层任务结构，离散但与任务相关的视觉状态的稀疏序列就足以解决许多熟悉的视觉推理问题。此外，交错模型的生成和推理成本显着降低，从而产生有利的准确性与效率权衡。A common intuition is that video generation should outperform interleaved text-image generation because videos provide dense temporal continuity. After task-specific training, however, we find that the strongest interleaved text-image model, VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1, performs on par with the strongest video model, VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, across many ID tasks. This suggests that, once the underlying task structure is learned, a sparse sequence of discrete but task-relevant visual states can be sufficient for solving many familiar visual reasoning problems. Moreover, interleaved models incur substantially lower generation and inference costs, yielding a favorable accuracy–efficiency trade-off.

然而，当成功的推理需要对状态转换进行精确建模时，视频生成仍然具有明显的优势。视频模型在 ID 转换任务和跨 OOD 类别上表现更好，这表明当模型必须跟踪随时间变化的细粒度变化或将学习到的转换动态推广到训练分布之外时，密集的时间表示变得特别有价值。这种区别在定性中得到了说明Video generation nevertheless retains a clear advantage when successful reasoning requires accurate modeling of state transitions. Video models perform better on ID transformation tasks and across OOD categories, suggesting that dense temporal representations become particularly valuable when models must track fine-grained changes over time or generalize learned transition dynamics beyond the training distribution. This distinction is qualitatively illustrated inFigure 7：视频模型生成连贯的中间状态，并在最短路径对象操作任务和: the video model generates coherent intermediate states and reaches the correct solution on both the shortest-path object-manipulation task and the180∘180^{\circ}块旋转任务，而交错文本图像和单图像模型失败。block-rotation task, whereas the interleaved text-image and single-image models fail.

单图像生成仍然比基于轨迹的表示弱得多，特别是在转换任务上。这可能是因为单个端点图像没有明确捕获解决方案过程中涉及的中间状态，它为建模多步骤状态转换提供了有限的支持。Single-image generation remains substantially weaker than both trajectory-based representations, particularly on transformation tasks. This might because a single endpoint image does not explicitly capture the intermediate states involved in the solution process, it provides limited support for modeling multi-step state transitions.

这些发现表明，对于 VBVR-Pro 中的视觉推理任务，显式视觉状态转换比中间文本推理贡献更大。基准测试中的许多任务，例如迷宫导航、对象平移和旋转，本质上是空间性的，需要跟踪位置、顺序、方向、路径和方向变化。一系列中间视觉状态使这些转换可以直接观察到，因此提供了底层推理过程的自然表示。These findings suggest that, for visual reasoning tasks in VBVR-Pro, explicit visual state transitions contribute more than intermediate textual reasoning. Many tasks in the benchmark, such as maze navigation, object translation and rotation, are inherently spatial and require tracking locations, order, directions, paths, and orientation changes. A sequence of intermediate visual states makes these transformations directly observable and therefore provides a natural representation of the underlying reasoning process.

4.2 反事实诊断Counterfactual Diagnostics

经过训练的模型的强大性能提出了一个重要的问题：特定任务的训练是否会引发可重用的视觉推理，或者模型是否会利用训练分布中的表面规律，例如重复的指令模板或提示与输出之间的记忆关联？我们进行了三种互补的反事实诊断来研究这个问题。第一个扰动输入文本或图像，以测试预测是否取决于潜在的问题实例而不是其表面​​公式。第二个干预中间推理状态，以确定哪种模态在推理过程中发挥更重要的作用。本节所有实验均在VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1上进行。The strong performance of trained models raises an important question: does task-specific training induce reusable visual reasoning, or does the model instead exploit superficial regularities in the training distribution, such as recurring instruction templates or memorized associations between prompts and outputs? We conduct three complementary counterfactual diagnostics to examine this question. The first perturbs the input text or image to test whether predictions depend on the underlying problem instance rather than its surface formulation. The second intervenes in intermediate reasoning states to determine which modality plays a more important role during the reasoning process. All experiments in this section are conducted on VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1.

4.2.1 对输入方式的干预Intervention on Input Modalities

如图所示As shown inTable 6, 干预#1Intervention #1使用原始输入文本和图像作为干净的参考。uses the original input text and image as the clean reference.干预#2Intervention #2在保留任务要求的同时，在语义上重新表述输入文本：性能基本不变，表明成功的推理不依赖于指令的特定语言形式。 相比之下，semantically rephrases the input text while preserving the task requirements: the performance is essentially unchanged, indicating that successful reasoning does not depend on the particular linguistic form of the instruction. In contrast,干预#3Intervention #3从输入文本中删除特定于任务的语义，仅保留通用输出要求。这导致了严重的退化，表明最初的文本仍然提供了必要的任务目标，而不仅仅是作为表面的触发因素。removes the task-specific semantics from the input text, retaining only generic output requirements. This causes a substantial degradation, showing that the initial text still provides necessary task objectives rather than merely serving as a superficial trigger.干预#4Intervention #4完全删除输入图像，同时保持输入文本不变，这在本实验中产生了迄今为止最大的退化，将性能降低至 0.064。因此，无法仅从文本输入中恢复该解决方案。removes the input image entirely while keeping the input text unchanged, which produces by far the largest degradation in this experiment, reducing performance to 0.064. The solution therefore cannot be recovered from the textual input alone.干预#5Intervention #5构造几何反事实，保留基本任务，但改变其视觉实现。具体来说，输入图像要么水平翻转，要么旋转constructs geometric counterfactuals that preserve the underlying taskbut change its visual realization. Specifically, the input image is either horizontally flipped or rotated by180∘180^{\circ}，并且输入文本中的方向相关语言的变换与相应的几何变换一致。在这些转变下，业绩仍然可观。当空间排列发生变化时，生成的推理轨迹也相应发生变化，但仍能达到正确的最终状态。, and direction-dependent language in the input text is transformed consistently with the corresponding geometric transformation. Performance remains substantial under these transformations. When the spatial arrangement changes, the generated reasoning trajectory changes accordingly and can still reach the correct final state.

总而言之，这些结果反对指令模板拟合或问题记忆：性能对输入文本的语义等效重新表述不敏感，但强烈依赖于任务语义，更重要的是，必须执行任务的特定视觉状态。因此，VBVR-Pro-Dataset 训练的收益很难解释为从重复出现的问题模式到输出的记忆映射；它们更符合学习可重用的视觉关系和操作。Taken together, these results argue against instruction-template fitting or question memorization: performance is insensitive to a semantically equivalent reformulation of the input text, but strongly dependent on both the task semantics and, more importantly, the specific visual state on which the task must be executed. The gains from VBVR-Pro-Dataset training are therefore difficult to explain as memorized mappings from recurring question patterns to outputs; they are more consistent with learning reusable visual relations and operations.

4.2.2 对中级推理状态的干预Intervention on Intermediate Reasoning States

同时WhileSection 4.1.4研究哪种形式的监督在训练期间最有用，在这里我们检查在训练模型的交错推理轨迹中实际使用了哪些信息。具体来说，我们在推理时直接干预中间输出，并测量它们对后续推出的因果贡献。studies which forms of supervision are most useful during training, here we examine which information is actually used during the interleaved reasoning trajectory of a trained model. Specifically, we intervene directly on intermediate outputs at inference time and measure their causal contribution to the subsequent rollout.

对于文本路径，For the textual pathway,干预#6Intervention #6在后续生成步骤之前删除中间文本，而removes the intermediate text before the subsequent generation step, while干预#7Intervention #7将其替换为矛盾的版本（replaces it with a contradictory version (\例如\eg.，将“左”更改为“右”）。两种干预措施都会导致类似的中度退化。这表明中间语言为推出提供了有用的上下文，但即使该信息被删除或变得不一致，推理轨迹仍保持部分功能。., changing “left” to “right”). Both interventions lead to similar, moderate degradation. This suggests that intermediate language provides useful context for the rollout, but the reasoning trajectory remains partially functional even when that information is removed or made inconsistent.

视觉通路要敏感得多。The visual pathway is considerably more sensitive.干预#8Intervention #8在将中间图像反馈到后续生成步骤之前将其删除，而removes the intermediate image before it is fed back into the subsequent generation step, while干预#9intervention #9用强噪声破坏中间图像。与文本干预相比，这两种干预都会导致更大的性能下降，完全删除会产生最严重的降级。由于最终输出图像本身并未直接修改，因此这些影响具体是由于破坏后续推理步骤可用的中间视觉状态而产生的。corrupts the intermediate image with strong noise. Both interventions cause substantially larger performance drops than the textual interventions, with complete removal producing the strongest degradation. Since the final output image itself is not directly modified, these effects arise specifically from disrupting the intermediate visual state available to subsequent reasoning steps.

对中间视觉干预的敏感性更强反映了训练时间的结果The stronger sensitivity to intermediate visual interventions mirrors the training-time result inSection 4.1.4。这两项分析共同提供了互补的证据：视觉轨迹不仅是训练期间更强的监督来源，而且在推理过程中也被积极使用。明确的文本推理可以支持推出，但中间视觉状态似乎可以作为更重要的工作表示。这种模式与维护和更新视觉状态的推理过程一致，语言扮演次要支持角色，而不是充当计算的主要基础。. Together, the two analyses provide complementary evidence: visual trajectories are not only a stronger source of supervision during training, but are also actively used during inference. Explicit textual reasoning can support the rollout, but the intermediate visual state appears to serve as the more consequential working representation. This pattern is consistent with a reasoning process that maintains and updates visual states, with language playing a secondary supporting role rather than serving as the primary substrate of computation.

4.3 步骤链：本机视觉推理的可视化Chain-of-Step: Visualization of Native Visual Reasoning

关注王Following Wang等\etal (Wang et al., 2026c)，他介绍了用于可视化视频扩散模型中的推理行为的工具，我们将相同的分析应用于视频和图像生成模型。具体来说，我们解码来自不同去噪步骤的噪声扩散潜伏，以检查在 VBVR-Pro-Dataset 上训练的模型的中间推理行为。我们分析了两个代表性模型：最强的视频生成模型VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-I2V-A14B和交错的文本图像生成模型VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1。 在这两种模式中，我们清楚地观察到, who introduce tools for visualizing reasoning behaviors in video diffusion models, we apply the same analysis to both video and image generation models. 5 具有可验证奖励的强化学习Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

这项工作的一个关键目标是检验大规模多任务强化学习（RL）用于视觉推理的可行性。我们强调，这并不是 RL 对于一般视觉生成的直接扩展：虽然传统的生成任务通常奖励像素级的保真度或美观性，但本机视觉推理需要满足通过语义转换和特定于任务的约束来表达的高级目标。在本节中，我们提出了用于视觉推理的端到端 RL 基线，包括优化算法（A key goal of this work is to examine the feasibility of large-scale multi-task reinforcement learning (RL) for visual reasoning. We emphasize that this is not a straightforward extension of RL for general visual generation: while conventional generative tasks often reward pixel-level fidelity or aesthetics, native visual reasoning requires satisfying high-level goals expressed through semantic transformations, and task-specific constraints. In this section, we present an end-to-end RL baseline for visual reasoning, including the optimization algorithm (Section 5.1）、训练食谱（), training recipes (Section 5.2）、定量分析（), quantitative analysis (Section 5.3）和定性案例研究（), and qualitative case studies (Section 5.4).

5.1 算法Algorithms

与组相关的优化方法，例如 Flow-GRPOGroup-relative optimization methods, such as Flow-GRPO(Liu et al., 2025)和舞蹈GRPOand DanceGRPO(Xue et al., 2025)，将反向去噪制定为顺序决策过程，并使用群体相关的终端奖励和修剪的策略目标来优化去噪策略。这些方法已成为 RL 增强视觉生成的流行选择。这种方法的一个关键要求是采样轨迹在与奖励相关的决策中有所不同，以便相对奖励提供有意义的优化信号。, formulate reverse denoising as a sequential decision process and optimize the denoising policy using group-relative terminal rewards together with a clipped policy objective. These methods have become popular choices for RL-enhanced visual generation. A key requirement for such approaches is that sampled trajectories differ in reward-relevant decisions, so that relative rewards provide meaningful optimization signals.

然而，在本机视觉推理中，有用的探索主要是In native visual reasoning, however, useful exploration is primarily语义semantic。该模型必须做出离散的、高影响力的决策，例如在迷宫中左转或右转、选择答案或确定要连接或标记哪些对象。标准随机扰动通常仅改变低级外观，同时保留相同的基本决策，为群体相对奖励估计提供很少有用的变化。如图所示. The model must make discrete, high-impact decisions, such as turning left or right in a maze, selecting an answer, or determining which objects to connect or mark. Standard stochastic perturbations often change only low-level appearance while preserving the same underlying decision, providing little useful variation for group-relative reward estimation. As illustrated inFigure 10，低随机性的推出经常收敛到类似的输出。因此，我们假设更强的随机性对于原生视觉推理任务中有效的强化学习探索是必要的。, low-stochasticity rollouts frequently converge to similar outputs. We therefore hypothesize that stronger stochasticity is necessary for effective RL exploration in native visual reasoning tasks.

与此同时，天真的增加随机性会严重损害视觉保真度。传统的 Flow-SDE 采样在探索和视觉质量之间呈现出不利的权衡。据分析At the same time, naively increasing stochasticity can severely damage visual fidelity. Conventional Flow-SDE sampling exhibits an unfavorable trade-off between exploration and visual quality. As analyzed by(Wang and Yu, 2025)，新注入的高斯噪声并未由调度程序规定的预测噪声分量精确补偿，从而使有效噪声幅度超过其预期水平。此行为可见于, newly injected Gaussian noise is not exactly compensated by the scheduler-prescribed predicted-noise component, allowing the effective noise magnitude to exceed its intended level. This behavior is visible inFigure 10：将 SDE 随机性增加到: increasing the SDE stochasticity toη=0.7\eta=0.7引入了大量的背景伪影和扭曲的对象边界，同时introduces substantial background artifacts and distorted object boundaries, whileη=0.9\eta=0.9严重破坏生成的帧并减少奖励。severely corrupts generated frames and reduces rewards.

相比之下，保留系数采样（CPS）In contrast, Coefficients-Preserving Sampling (CPS)(Wang and Yu, 2025)提供更好的探索与保真度权衡。更强的 CPS 噪声会导致明显不同的任务级别决策和更广泛的奖励，同时在很大程度上保留干净的形状和背景。在provides a better exploration–fidelity trade-off. Stronger CPS noise induces visibly different task-level decisions and a wider range of rewards while largely preserving clean shapes and backgrounds. InFigure 10，即使在高随机性下，CPS 也会继续产生视觉上干净的展示，同时支持不同的语义决策。这些观察结果促使我们使用 CPS 进行 RL 探索。因此，我们在 RL 基线中采用 CPS：, CPS continues to produce visually clean rollouts even at high stochasticity, while supporting diverse semantic decisions. These observations motivate our use of CPS for RL exploration. We therefore adopt CPS in our RL baseline:

CPS can therefore introduce sufficient stochasticity for exploring alternative visual decisions while avoiding excessive noise accumulation, thereby preserving rollout quality and providing more reliable reward signals.

5.2 数据和训练方法Data and Training Recipes

本节中的所有实验都从 VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 开始，并使用 VBVR-Pro 数据集的相同 50K RL 子集，涵盖 50 个域内任务。在应用下面的任何训练策略之前，我们参考原始的 VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 检查点作为基线。这种受控设置隔离了训练目标和奖励信号的影响。All experiments in this section start from VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and use the same 50K RL subset of the VBVR-Pro Dataset, spanning 50 in-domain tasks. We refer to the original VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-TI2V-5B checkpoint, before applying any of the training strategies below, as the baseline. This controlled setup isolates the effects of the training objective and reward signal.

有监督微调（SFT）。Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).我们使用监督目标直接在 50K 训练实例上微调模型，在相同的数据预算下提供非 RL 基线。We fine-tune the model directly on the 50K training instances using a supervised objective, providing a non-RL baseline under the same data budget.

使用 VLM 奖励 (RLVLM) 进行强化学习。Reinforcement Learning with VLM Rewards (RLVLM).该变体使用Qwen3.6-27BThis variant uses Qwen3.6-27B(Qwen Team, 2026a)作为一名 VLM 裁判。法官评估每个生成的样本并提供用于策略优化的奖励。as a VLM judge. The judge evaluates each generated sample and provides the reward used for policy optimization.

具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR).该变体使用了提议的 VBVR Scorer，它可以根据底层真实元数据确定性地计算特定于任务的可验证奖励。This variant uses the proposed VBVR Scorer, which deterministically computes task-specific verifiable rewards from the underlying ground-truth metadata.

RLVLM和RLVR使用相同的RL算法、rollout配置、优化超参数、训练数据和模型初始化；它们的区别仅在于奖励信号的来源。因此，他们的比较直接衡量了用所提出的基于任务的可验证奖励替换通用 VLM 判断的效果。在本文的其余部分中，我们使用术语 RLVLM 和 RLVR 来表示这两种奖励变体。RLVLM and RLVR use the same RL algorithm, rollout configuration, optimization hyperparameters, training data, and model initialization; they differ only in the source of the reward signal. Therefore, their comparison directly measures the effect of replacing a general-purpose VLM judge with the proposed task-grounded verifiable reward. We use the terms RLVLM and RLVR to denote these two reward variants throughout the remainder of the paper.

域外结果尤其值得注意。尽管 RL 训练期间没有使用域外任务，但两个 RL 目标都比 SFT 有所改进，RLLVLM 和 RLVR 分别达到 0.345 和 0.377，而 SFT 为 0.328。这些成果表明，奖励引导的优化可以提高 RL 训练分布之外的泛化能力。 RLVR 获得的额外改进进一步表明，基于任务的可验证反馈可以为可转移视觉推理提供更强的信号。The Out-of-Domain results are particularly noteworthy. Although no Out-of-Domain tasks are used during RL training, both RL objectives improve over SFT, with RLVLM and RLVR reaching 0.345 and 0.377, respectively, compared with 0.328 for SFT. These gains suggest that reward-guided optimization can improve generalization beyond the RL training distribution. The additional improvement obtained by RLVR further indicates that task-grounded verifiable feedback can provide a stronger signal for transferable visual reasoning.

5.4 案例研究Case Studies

总体基准分数表明 RLVR 提高了最终任务性能，但没有揭示 RL 如何改变潜在的视觉推理轨迹。关注王Aggregate benchmark scores show that RLVR improves final-task performance, but they do not reveal how RL changes the underlying visual reasoning trajectory. Following Wang等\etal (Wang et al., 2026c)，我们可视化模型在沿去噪轨迹的选定点处对最终视频的瞬时预测。我们将用作 RL 起点的 SFT 初始化策略（称为预 RL 模型）与最终的 RLVR 模型进行比较。以下示例说明了推理行为中的两个互补变化：跨降噪步骤的持续修订和多步骤空间计划的更连贯的执行。, we visualize the model’s instantaneous prediction of the final video at selected points along the denoising trajectory. We compare the SFT-initialized policy used as the starting point for RL, referred to as the pre-RL model, with the resulting RLVR model. The following examples illustrate two complementary changes in reasoning behavior: continued revision across denoising steps and more coherent execution of a multi-step spatial plan.

在如图所示的颜色序列任务中In the color-sequence task shown inFigure 12，预强化学习模型在前几个去噪步骤中确定其答案，并且在轨迹的其余部分中不会重新考虑它。 RLVR 最初也是不正确的，但它的预测仍然可以修改：预测的颜色在第 6 步发生变化，随后收敛到正确的答案。由于两个模型都使用相同的 30 步采样计划，因此观察到的差异不能归因于额外的推理计算。相反，RLVR 在最初的去噪步骤之外继续执行与任务相关的细化，提供了后续步骤自我校正的示例。, the pre-RL model determines its answer within the first few denoising steps and does not reconsider it during the remainder of the trajectory. RLVR is also incorrect initially, but its prediction remains revisable: the predicted color changes at Step 6 and subsequently converges to the correct answer. Because both models use the same 30-step sampling schedule, the observed difference cannot be attributed to additional inference computation. Instead, RLVR continues to perform task-relevant refinement beyond the initial denoising steps, providing an example of later-step self-correction.

迷宫的例子在The maze example inFigure 13展示了不同形式的改进。预强化学习模型将代理放置在跨帧的断开位置，并且无法维持穿过迷宫的有效路线。相比之下，RLVR 产生时间上更加一致的代理状态序列，很大程度上遵循连接的走廊，并最终到达目标。因此，改进不仅涉及最终状态，还涉及中间轨迹的连贯性，这表明维护和执行多步骤空间计划的能力更强。demonstrates a different form of improvement. The pre-RL model places the agent at disconnected locations across frames and fails to maintain a valid route through the maze. In contrast, RLVR produces a more temporally consistent sequence of agent states, largely follows connected corridors, and eventually reaches the target. The improvement therefore concerns not only the final state but also the coherence of the intermediate trajectory, suggesting a stronger ability to maintain and execute a multi-step spatial plan.

这些例子共同说明了 RLVR 的两个互补效应。首先，它在固定的去噪预算内扩展了有效的推理范围，允许模型修改在初始步骤中原本固定的决策。其次，它提高了生成的视频帧之间状态转换的时间一致性。其他定性示例提供于Together, these examples illustrate two complementary effects of RLVR. First, it extends the effective reasoning horizon within a fixed denoising budget, allowing the model to revise decisions that would otherwise become fixed during the initial steps. Second, it improves the temporal consistency of state transitions across generated video frames. Additional qualitative examples are provided inSection B.7.

6 相关工作Related Work

通过视觉生成进行本机视觉推理。Native visual reasoning through visual generation.

原生视觉推理，广义上定义为通过视觉生成进行推理，最近受到越来越多的关注。维德默Native visual reasoning, broadly defined as reasoning through visual generation, has recently received increasing attention. Wiedemer等\etal (Wiedemer et al., 2025)观察到视频模型是推理者，并确定了observed that video models are reasoners, and identified the帧链Chain-of-Frames（CoF）范式。遵循这个方向，OpenCoF(CoF) paradigm. Following this direction, OpenCoF(Chen et al., 2026c)在视频生成器中引入可学习的推理标记。王introduces learnable reasoning tokens in the video generators. Wang等\etal (Wang et al., 2026c)进一步确定不同的机制，further identify a different mechanism,步骤链Chain-of-Steps（CoS），其中推理通过扩散去噪步骤展开，这一现象得到了后来的研究进一步支持(CoS), where reasoning unfolds through diffusion denoising steps, a phenomenon further supported by later studies(Newman et al., 2026)。尽管该范式具有以视觉为中心的性质，但 MLLM 也已被纳入辅助视频推理器。程. Despite the vision-centric nature of this paradigm, MLLMs have also been incorporated to assist video reasoners. Cheng等\etal (Cheng et al., 2026b)使用 MLLM 进行视频推理机的测试时优化，而 VChainuse MLLMs for test-time optimization of video reasoners, while VChain(Huang et al., 2026)注入 MLLM 衍生的推理信号，injects MLLM-derived reasoning signals,\即\ie视觉思维链，在推理时指导视频生成。 除了视频之外，图像生成也被探索作为本地视觉推理的基础。差异思考者Chain-of-Visual-Thought, to guide video generation at inference time. Beyond video, image generation has also been explored as a substrate for native visual reasoning. DiffThinker(He et al., 2025b)将视觉推理重新表述为跨四个视觉推理任务的本机图像到图像生成任务，而 EndoCoTreformulates visual reasoning as a native image-to-image generative task across four visual reasoning tasks, while EndoCoT(Dai et al., 2026)提炼潜在思想来指导图像生成。然而，现有的研究通常是在有限的视觉任务上进行验证，这很大程度上是由于缺乏支持大规模多样化训练、可验证评估和跨生成模式的系统比较的统一基础设施。这就是我们在这项工作中旨在解决的差距。refines latent thoughts to guide image generation. However, existing studies are typically validated on a limited set of visual tasks, largely due to the lack of unified infrastructure that supports large-scale diverse training, verifiable evaluation, and systematic comparison across generative modalities. This is the gap we aim to address in this work.

交错的视觉文本推理。Interleaved visual-textual reasoning.

基于语言的推理的成功自然激发了中间视觉状态与文本原理的交织The success of language-based reasoning has naturally motivated interleaving intermediate visual states with textual rationales(Dong et al., 2026a)。在通过生成进行推理的更广泛范式中，最近的方法使模型能够使用外部工具绘制草图. Within the broader paradigm of reasoning through generation, recent methods enable models to sketch with external tools(Hu et al., 2024)，可视化推理痕迹, visualize reasoning traces(Li et al., 2025b)，将可视化编辑融入推理工具中, incorporate visual editing into a reasoning harness(Zhang et al., 2026)，或者从大规模交错语料库中学习, or learn from large-scale interleaved corpora(Li et al., 2025a; Wang et al., 2026b; Gu et al., 2025)。并行工作线调查需要多少显式视觉状态，将视觉推理压缩为更新标记. A parallel line of work investigates how much explicit visual state is needed, compressing visual reasoning into update tokens(Wang et al., 2026b)或潜在标记or latent tokens(Yang et al., 2026; Dong et al., 2026b; Chen et al., 2026a)。超越交错文本图像建模，SC-CMJP. Beyond interleaved text-image modeling, SC-CMJP(Le et al., 2026)利用掩模扩散模型联合生成文本和图像以进行编辑和视觉推理任务。虽然这些方法显着扩展了视觉推理的设计空间，但它们通常继承了以语言为中心的视图，其中视觉状态充当文本推理的辅助支持。相比之下，我们的工作系统地研究视觉轨迹本身作为一流的推理基础。leverages masked diffusion models to jointly generate text and images for editing and visual reasoning tasks. While these approaches significantly expand the design space of visual reasoning, they often inherit a language-centric view in which visual states serve as auxiliary supports for textual reasoning. In contrast, our work systematically investigates visual trajectories themselves as first-class reasoning substrates.

视觉推理的强化学习。Reinforcement learning for visual reasoning.

用于一般视觉生成的强化学习已被广泛研究Reinforcement learning for general visual generation has been extensively studied(Liu et al., 2025; Xue et al., 2025; Zheng et al., 2025; Wang and Yu, 2025; Cheng et al., 2025; Bu et al., 2026)，主要是为了提高教学质量和审美质量。然而，视觉推理任务需要模型达到语义上有效的解决方案；针对此类视觉推理目标的强化学习仍相对未得到充分探索。对于交错生成，最近的方法在统一的 RL 目标下联合优化文本和图像策略, primarily to improve instruction following and aesthetic quality. However, visual reasoning tasks require models to reach semantically valid solutions; RL for such visual reasoning objectives remains comparatively underexplored. For interleaved generation, recent approaches jointly optimize text and image policies under unified RL objectives(Liu et al., 2026a; Hu et al., 2026; Cheng et al., 2026a)，但他们的视觉状态仍然通常由基于 VLM 的评委进行评估。 VPRL, but their visual states are still commonly evaluated by VLM-based judges. VPRL(Xu et al., 2026)在没有语言的情况下改进了三个视觉导航任务的大视觉模型，而VideoRLVRimproves large vision models on three visual navigation tasks without language, while VideoRLVR(Zhu et al., 2026)展示了在三个视觉任务上获得可验证奖励的承诺。然而，现有的研究在规模和任务多样性方面仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们在 50 项具有可验证奖励的任务中进行联合 RL 训练，并评估 100 项任务的结果模型，从而能够对多任务原生视觉推理进行更广泛的研究。demonstrates the promise of verifiable rewards on three visual tasks. Nevertheless, existing studies remain limited in scale and task diversity. In this work, we perform joint RL training across 50 tasks with verifiable rewards and evaluate the resulting models on 100 tasks, enabling a substantially broader study of multi-task native visual reasoning.

视觉推理基准和培训来源。Visual reasoning benchmarks and training sources.

现有的视觉推理基准跨越视频生成Existing visual reasoning benchmarks span video generation(Tong et al., 2026; Luo et al., 2025b; He et al., 2025a; Liu et al., 2026c; Pan et al., 2026), 图像编辑, image editing(Zhao et al., 2026b; Wu et al., 2026; Chen et al., 2026b; Liu et al., 2026b)，以及统一的多模式生成, and unified multimodal generation(Zhou et al., 2025; Zou et al., 2026; Zhou et al., 2026; Shi et al., 2026)。然而，大多数这些基准仅用于评估（. However, most of these benchmarks are evaluation-only (Table 1）：他们对培训提供的监督很少，并且经常依赖基于 VLM 的评判，而评判的评估可能难以验证和重现。一些交错语料库达到训练规模): they offer little supervision for training and often rely on VLM-based judges, whose evaluations can be difficult to verify and reproduce. A few interleaved corpora reach training scale(Li et al., 2025a; Wang et al., 2026b)，但它们的任务覆盖范围仍然有限，更重要的是，它们不是程序生成的，因此很难获得可验证的评估信号或基于任务的奖励。 VBVR, but they remain limited in task coverage and, more importantly, are not procedurally generated, making it difficult to obtain verifiable evaluation signals or task-grounded rewards. VBVR(Wang et al., 2026a)提供大规模监督和可验证评估，但其任务空间可以进一步扩展到更广泛、更具挑战性和更可转移的视觉推理能力。 VBVR-Pro 在此基础上提供了更大的受控任务空间、可验证的奖励评分器、多任务强化学习训练以及跨图像、视频和交错生成模型的系统模态比较。provides both large-scale supervision and verifiable evaluation, but its task space can be further expanded toward broader, more challenging, and more transferable visual reasoning capabilities. VBVR-Pro builds on this foundation by providing a larger controlled task space, verifiable reward scorers, multi-task RL training, and systematic modality comparisons across image, video, and interleaved generative models.

7 结论Conclusion

通过统一程序生成的视觉推理环境、基于任务的可验证奖励、强化学习和模态控制机制分析，VBVR-Pro 通过生成将本机视觉推理建立为可训练、可验证和实验可控的研究问题。我们的迁移研究、反事实诊断、视觉状态干预、轨迹可视化和奖励驱动优化共同表明，视觉生成模型可以构建、维护和完善中间视觉轨迹，将视觉生成不仅作为一种输出格式，而且作为推理的真正基础。这些发现呼吁更多地关注本机视觉推理作为以语言为中心的推理的补充范式，我们希望 VBVR-Pro 为未来的研究提供有用的基础。By unifying procedurally generated visual reasoning environments, task-grounded verifiable rewards, reinforcement learning, and modality-controlled mechanism analyses, VBVR-Pro establishes native visual reasoning through generation as a trainable, verifiable, and experimentally controllable research problem. Our transfer studies, counterfactual diagnostics, visual-state interventions, trajectory visualizations, and reward-driven optimization collectively suggest that visual generative models can construct, maintain, and refine intermediate visual trajectories, positioning visual generation not merely as an output format but as a genuine substrate for reasoning. These findings call for greater attention to native visual reasoning as a complementary paradigm to language-centric reasoning, and we hope VBVR-Pro provides a useful foundation for the future research.

附录AAppendix A基线模型架构的详细信息Details of baseline model architectures

A.1 图像、视频和交错生成器Image, Video, and Interleaved Generators

为了评估 VBVR-Pro-Dataset 训练的有效性，我们对涵盖图像生成、视频生成和交错文本图像生成的多种生成基础模型进行了微调。它们的架构特性总结为To evaluate the effectiveness of training on the VBVR-Pro-Dataset, we fine-tune a diverse set of generative foundation models spanning image generation, video generation, and interleaved text-image generation. Their architectural properties are summarized inTable 9，其中提供了其他特定于模型的详细信息, with additional model-specific details provided inAppendix A。它们在模型规模、跨模式交互机制和输出表示方面存在很大差异。这种架构多样性使我们能够检查 VBVR-Pro-Dataset 微调的好处是否可以推广到不同的生成模式和模型设计，包括稀疏和密集架构以及潜在空间和像素空间生成。. They vary substantially in model scale, cross-modal interaction mechanisms, and output representations. This architectural diversity enables us to examine whether the benefits of fine-tuning on VBVR-Pro-Dataset generalize across different generative modalities and model designs, including sparse and dense architectures as well as latent- and pixel-space generation.

  • •

    图像生成模型。Image generation models.

    • –

      百吉饼-7B-MoTBAGEL-7B-MoT (Deng et al., 2025)是一个统一的多模态模型，支持混合变压器 (MoT) 架构中的多模态理解和图像生成。其语言理解和视觉生成路径使用单独的 Transformer 参数，同时参与通用的多模态序列，从而允许模型根据标记类型进行专门计算。完整的检查点包含大约 14B 个参数，但对于给定的令牌路径，只有大约 7B 个参数是活动的。is a unified multimodal model that supports both multimodal understanding and image generation within a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Its language-understanding and visual-generation pathways use separate Transformer parameters while participating in a common multimodal sequence, allowing the model to specialize computation by token type. The full checkpoint contains approximately 14B parameters, but only about 7B are active for a given token pathway.

    • –

      Qwen-图像-编辑Qwen-Image-Edit (Wu et al., 2025)建立在 20B 参数 Qwen-Image 基础模型之上，并使用多模态扩散 Transformer (DiT) 来执行图像生成和指令引导编辑。其双流模块最初保持视觉潜伏和多模态条件的独特表示，同时在整个去噪过程中实现它们之间的交互。is built on the 20B-parameter Qwen-Image foundation model and uses a multimodal diffusion Transformer (DiT) to perform both image generation and instruction-guided editing. Its dual-stream blocks initially maintain distinct representations for visual latents and multimodal conditioning while enabling interaction between them throughout denoising.

    • –

      FLUX.2-dev (BlackForestLabs, 2025)的 Transformer 从双流块开始，分别处理视觉和条件令牌，然后过渡到联合处理连接令牌序列的单流块。与早期的 FLUX 架构相比，FLUX.2 将更大比例的深度和参数分配给联合单流阶段，为跨模式合成和参考图像集成提供更大的能力。’s Transformer begins with dual-stream blocks that process visual and conditioning tokens separately and then transitions to single-stream blocks that jointly process the concatenated token sequence. Compared with earlier FLUX architectures, FLUX.2 allocates a larger fraction of its depth and parameters to the joint single-stream stage, providing greater capacity for cross-modal composition and reference-image integration.

  • •

    交错文本图像生成模型。Interleaved text-image generation models.

    • –

      ThinkMorph-7B (Gu et al., 2025)从 BAGEL-7B-MoT 初始化并在文本图像推理轨迹上进行微调。因此，它保留了 BAGEL 的 14B-total、7B-active Mixture-of-Transformers 架构和 VAE 潜在图像生成路径。is initialized from BAGEL-7B-MoT and fine-tuned on text-image reasoning trajectories. It therefore retains BAGEL’s 14B-total, 7B-active Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and VAE-latent image-generation pathway.

    • –

      SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT (Diao et al., 2026)是一个原生统一模型，它将多模态理解和生成视为公共 Transformer 中的操作，而不是作为单独的编码器和解码器管道。其 NEO-unify 架构去除了传统的视觉编码器和生成 VAE。相反，图像被直接转换为 RGB 像素块，使用特定于模态的 Transformer 参数与语言标记一起进行处理，并通过轻量级像素输出头进行重建。is a native unified model that treats multimodal understanding and generation as operations within a common Transformer rather than as separate encoder and decoder pipelines. Its NEO-unify architecture removes both the conventional visual encoder and the generative VAE. Images are instead converted directly into RGB pixel patches, processed alongside language tokens using modality-specific Transformer parameters, and reconstructed through a lightweight pixel-output head.

  • •

    视频生成模型。Video generation models.

    • –

      万2.2-I2V-A14BWan2.2-I2V-A14B (WanTeam, 2025)是一个稀疏专家混合模型，具有单独的高噪声和低噪声降噪器。每个专家都是完整的 14B 级视频 DiT，但在去噪轨迹中的每个点上只有一名专家处于活动状态。is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with separate high-noise and low-noise denoisers. Each expert is a full 14B-class video DiT, but only one expert is active at each point in the denoising trajectory.

    • –

      万2.2-TI2V-5BWan2.2-TI2V-5B (WanTeam, 2025)是一个密集的视频 DiT。与 A14B 变体相比，它在整个去噪轨迹中使用相同的 5B 参数主干，而不是在噪声专业专家之间路由计算。is a dense video DiT. In contrast to the A14B variant, it uses the same 5B-parameter backbone throughout the denoising trajectory rather than routing computation between noise-specialized experts.

    • –

      万2.1-I2V-14B-720PWan2.1-I2V-14B-720P (WanTeam, 2025)是一个密集的 14B 参数视频 DiT，它在所有去噪时间步上应用单个 40 块 Transformer 主干，并生成视频作为压缩的时空 VAE 潜伏。is a dense 14B-parameter video DiT that applies a single 40-block Transformer backbone at all denoising timesteps and generates videos as compressed spatiotemporal VAE latents.

    • –

      LTX-2.3-I2AV (HaCohen et al., 2026)是一个统一的视听扩散模型，共同生成同步的视频和音频。它的主干是一个非对称双流变压器，为视频流分配比音频流更多的容量，以反映它们不同的信息密度。这些流在单独的视频和音频 VAE 潜伏上运行，并通过双向视听交叉注意力、时间位置编码和跨模态自适应归一化交换信息。is a unified audiovisual diffusion model that jointly generates synchronized video and audio. Its backbone is an asymmetric dual-stream Transformer, assigning substantially more capacity to the video stream than to the audio stream to reflect their differing information densities. The streams operate on separate video and audio VAE latents and exchange information through bidirectional audiovisual cross-attention, temporal positional encoding, and cross-modal adaptive normalization.

A.1.1 训练食谱Training Recipes

所有模型都针对一个时期进行了微调，分辨率为All models are fine-tuned for one epoch at a resolution of512×512512\times 512。我们根据模型规模和模态采用统一的微调策略。对于图像生成和交错文本图像生成模型，活动参数少于 10B 的模型经过完全微调，而较大的模型则采用 LoRA 进行调整。对于所有视频生成模型，我们始终使用 LoRA 微调。. We adopt a unified fine-tuning strategy based on model scale and modality. For image generation and interleaved text-image generation models, models with fewer than 10B active parameters are fully fine-tuned, while larger models are adapted with LoRA. For all video generation models, we consistently use LoRA fine-tuning.

对于图像生成，Qwen-Image-Edit 和 FLUX.2-dev 使用 Rank-32 LoRA 进行调整，学习率为For image generation, Qwen-Image-Edit and FLUX.2-dev are adapted using rank-32 LoRA with a learning rate of1×10−41\times 10^{-4}，而 BAGEL 是完全微调的，学习率较小, whereas BAGEL is fully fine-tuned with a smaller learning rate of5×10−65\times 10^{-6}。对于 Qwen-Image-Edit 和 FLUX.2-dev，LoRA 适配器应用于查询、键、值和输出投影，以及选定的多模态投影、前馈和调制层。对于交错文本图像生成，ThinkMorph 和 SenseNova-U1 使用以下学习率进行完全微调. For Qwen-Image-Edit and FLUX.2-dev, the LoRA adapters are applied to the query, key, value, and output projections, as well as selected multimodal projection, feed-forward, and modulation layers. For interleaved text-image generation, ThinkMorph and SenseNova-U1 are fully fine-tuned using learning rates of1×10−51\times 10^{-5}和and2×10−52\times 10^{-5}， 分别。对于视频生成，我们将Rank-32 LoRA应用于所有评估的模型，包括Wan2.2-I2V-A14B、Wan2.2-TI2V-5B、Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P和LTX-2.3-I2AV。适配器应用于查询、键、值和输出投影，前馈投影还适用于 Wan 模型。所有视频模型均经过训练, respectively. For video generation, we apply rank-32 LoRA to all evaluated models, including Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P, and LTX-2.3-I2AV. The adapters are applied to the query, key, value, and output projections, with the feed-forward projections additionally adapted for the Wan models. All video models are trained at1616学习率为 fpsfps with a learning rate of1×10−41\times 10^{-4}.

具体来说，为了隔离和评估 VBVR-Pro-Dataset 训练数据的贡献，VBVR-SenseNova-U1 和 VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1 从未发布的预训练检查点进行初始化，该检查点在预训练期间从未暴露于 VBVR 数据。此设置使我们能够更清楚地将所产生的性能提升归因于 VBVR/VBVR-Pro 微调。Specifically, to isolate and assess the contribution of the VBVR-Pro-Dataset training data, VBVR-SenseNova-U1 and VBVR-Pro-SenseNova-U1 are initialized from an unreleased pretrained checkpoint that has never been exposed to VBVR data during pretraining. This setup allows us to more cleanly attribute the resulting performance gains to VBVR/VBVR-Pro fine-tuning.

附录BAppendix B强化学习详情Reinforcement Learning Details

B.1 培训渠道Training Pipeline

为了提高训练效率，我们采用了一种单步延迟推出管道，将奖励计算与 GPU 端推出生成和策略优化重叠。如图所示To improve training efficiency, we adopt a one-step-delayed rollout pipeline that overlaps reward computation with GPU-side rollout generation and policy optimization. As illustrated inFigure 14，同步管道需要策略优化来等待转出预处理和奖励评估完成，从而导致大量 GPU 空闲时间。, the synchronous pipeline requires policy optimization to wait for rollout preprocessing and reward evaluation to complete, resulting in substantial GPU idle time.

受到 DeepCoder 的启发Inspired by DeepCoder(Luo et al., 2025a)和面积and AReaL(Fu et al., 2026)，我们的管道在推出生成和优化之间引入了固定的一步延迟。推出后, our pipeline introduces a fixed one-step delay between rollout generation and optimization. After rolloutkk生成后，其预处理和奖励计算会异步分派给奖励工作人员，同时 GPU 继续生成 rolloutis generated, its preprocessing and reward computation are asynchronously dispatched to reward workers, while the GPUs continue generating rolloutk+1k+1。一旦推出奖励. Once the rewards for rolloutkk可用后，GPU 使用 rollout 执行策略优化become available, the GPUs perform policy optimization using rolloutkk当奖励工作人员流程推出时while the reward workers process rolloutk+1k+1。此设计从关键执行路径中删除了奖励计算，并提高了 GPU 利用率。. This design removes reward computation from the critical execution path and improves GPU utilization.

与完全异步的强化学习系统不同，我们的方法保留了确定性的执行顺序，并将策略过时性限制为最多一次推出迭代。因此，它实现了奖励计算和策略执行之间的有效重叠，同时避免了过多的策略滞后。Unlike fully asynchronous reinforcement learning systems, our approach preserves a deterministic execution order and bounds policy staleness to at most one rollout iteration. Therefore, it achieves efficient overlap between reward computation and policy execution while avoiding excessive policy lag.

为了进一步减少部署开销，我们在以下位置生成训练样本To further reduce rollout overhead, we generate training samples at512×512512\times 512分辨率并仅将它们升级到resolution and only upscale them to1024×10241024\times 1024在奖励计算期间。该策略降低了轨迹生成的成本，同时保持了奖励评估的高分辨率输入。during reward computation. This strategy reduces the cost of trajectory generation while maintaining high-resolution inputs for reward evaluation.

如何有效地利用这种重叠还取决于奖励评估的系统成本。 RLVR 使用的可验证记分器在 CPU 奖励工作线程上运行，因此可以与 GPU 端部署生成和策略优化重叠，而无需占用加速器内存。相比之下，RLVLM 需要将 Qwen-3.6-27B 作为 GPU 驻留奖励模型；在我们的实现中，我们保留 50% 的可用 GPU 内存用于判断推理。这种差异反映在端到端训练时间上：在 128 个 H800 GPU 上，使用可验证评分器训练 2,200 个步骤大约需要 5.1 天，而使用 VLM Judge 则需要 8.3 天。因此 RLVR 提供了How effectively this overlap can be exploited also depends on the systems cost of reward evaluation. The verifiable scorer used by RLVR runs on CPU reward workers and can therefore overlap with GPU-side rollout generation and policy optimization without occupying accelerator memory. In contrast, RLVLM requires serving Qwen-3.6-27B as a GPU-resident reward model; in our implementation, we reserve 50% of the available GPU memory for judge inference. This difference is reflected in end-to-end training time: on 128 H800 GPUs, training for 2,200 steps takes approximately 5.1 days with the verifiable scorer, compared with 8.3 days with the VLM judge. RLVR therefore provides a1.63×1.63\times训练吞吐量增加，挂钟时间减少 38.7%。increase in training throughput and reduces wall-clock time by 38.7%.

B.2 训练优化Training Optimizations

我们根据参考策略研究 KL 正则化，这在群体相关策略优化中通常采用。维护显式参考模型需要额外的前向计算和内存消耗。尽管 Shadow KL 等轻量级替代方案避免了显式参考模型评估，但我们发现 KL 正则化在我们的设置中并没有提供一致的增益。因此，所有实验都是在没有 KL 正则化的情况下进行的。We investigate KL regularization with respect to a reference policy, which is commonly adopted in group-relative policy optimization. Maintaining an explicit reference model requires additional forward computation and memory consumption. Although lightweight alternatives such as Shadow KL avoid explicit reference-model evaluation, we find that KL regularization does not provide consistent gains in our setting. Therefore, all experiments are conducted without KL regularization.

为了高效的大规模训练，我们用融合的 Liger Kernel 替换了原生 RMSNorm 实现For efficient large-scale training, we replace the native RMSNorm implementation with the fused Liger Kernel(Hsu et al., 2024)，使用 FlashAttention-3, employ FlashAttention-3(Shah et al., 2024)用于内存高效的注意力计算，并启用for memory-efficient attention computation, and enable火炬编译torch.compile每当兼容时。我们还使用混合分片 FSDP2whenever compatible. We additionally use hybrid-sharded FSDP2(Zhao et al., 2023b)，它对每个节点内的模型状态进行分片，同时保持节点之间的数据并行同步。, which shards model states within each node while maintaining data-parallel synchronization across nodes.

B.3 训练和推理配置Training and Inference Configuration

在 RL 训练期间，我们使用 CPS 采样器进行 30 个采样步骤。对于策略优化，按照 中描述的公式重放 60% 的去噪转换During RL training, we use 30 sampling steps with the CPS sampler. For policy optimization, 60% of the denoising transitions are replayed, following the formulation described inSection 5.1。每个优化批次包含 32 个提示，每个提示采样 32 个轨迹。我们将 CPS 随机性参数设置为. Each optimization batch contains 32 prompts, with 32 trajectories sampled per prompt. We set the CPS stochasticity parameter toη=0.7\eta=0.7并使用学习率and use a learning rate of5×10−65\times 10^{-6}。除非另有说明，所有 RL 实验均使用 CFG 尺度 1.0。. Unless otherwise specified, all RL experiments use a CFG scale of 1.0.

为了在主论文中进行受控比较，可验证的 RL 和 VLM-Judge RL 均使用 CPS 进行评估For the controlled comparison in the main paper, both Verifiable-RL and VLM-Judge RL are evaluated using CPS withη=0.7\eta=0.7。这种匹配的配置将奖励目标的影响与推理采样器的影响隔离开来。所有 RL 评估均使用 30 个降噪步骤，与训练期间使用的 rollout 配置相匹配。. This matched configuration isolates the effect of the reward objective from that of the inference sampler. All RL evaluations use 30 denoising steps, matching the rollout configuration used during training.

我们还在采样器敏感性研究中使用 Euler 和 UniPC 评估了确定性 ODE 采样。 CPS 参考实现We additionally evaluate deterministic ODE sampling with Euler and UniPC in the sampler-sensitivity study. The CPS reference implementation(Wang and Yu, 2025)使用欧拉离散化作为其确定性 ODE 主干，而官方的 Wan 推理管道默认采用 UniPC。 Euler 是一阶单步求解器，而 UniPCuses an Euler discretization as its deterministic ODE backbone, whereas the official Wan inference pipeline adopts UniPC by default. Euler is a first-order single-step solver, while UniPC(Zhao et al., 2023a)使用高阶预测校正公式。我们将这些配置分别称为 ODE (Euler) 和 ODE (UniPC)。两者都使用相同的 30 步计划和 CFG 尺度作为 RL 评估，确保求解器是唯一被更改的推理变量。uses a higher-order predictor–corrector formulation. We refer to these configurations as ODE (Euler) and ODE (UniPC), respectively. Both use the same 30-step schedule and CFG scale as the RL evaluation, ensuring that the solver is the only inference variable being changed.

对于监督微调（SFT）基线，我们保留了官方 Wan 实现的默认推理配置：UniPC，采样步长为 50，CFG 比例为 5。此配置与原始模型推理管道保持不变。For the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baseline, we retain the default inference configuration of the official Wan implementation: UniPC with 50 sampling steps and a CFG scale of 5. This configuration is kept unchanged from the original model inference pipeline.
