For VLM-Judge RL, the differences among samplers are smaller and less consistent. Higher-stochasticity CPS reaches a higher performance ceiling but also exhibits a pronounced temporary drop around Steps 400–500, whereas the deterministic ODE trajectories are smoother. Thus, stochastic sampling provides useful exploration when paired with a reliable verifiable reward, but can amplify errors that are not adequately penalized by the VLM judge. We analyze this behavior below.

B.5 VLM-Judge不稳定性分析Analysis of VLM-Judge Instability

正如观察到的As observed inFigures 11和and15，VLM-Judge RL 在 CPS 下在步骤 400-500 附近表现出暂时的性能下降, VLM-Judge RL exhibits a temporary performance drop around Steps 400–500 under CPS withη=0.7\eta=0.7。同样的行为变得更加明显. The same behavior becomes more pronounced withη=0.9\eta=0.9。我们通过比较检查点 500 处的推理采样器并跟踪附近训练检查点的相应故障模式来调查这种不稳定性。. We investigate this instability by comparing inference samplers at Checkpoint 500 and tracing the corresponding failure mode across nearby training checkpoints.

Figure 16比较检查点处的推理采样器，表现出最大的性能下降。前景变换在采样器中基本保持正确，但随着 CPS 随机性的增加，生成的背景逐渐变灰。相比之下，低随机性 CPS 和确定性 ODE 采样在很大程度上保留了目标白色背景。因此，这种下降反映了与采样器相关的视觉保真度下降，而不是底层推理能力的完全失败。compares inference samplers at the checkpoint exhibiting the largest performance drop. The foreground transformations remain largely correct across samplers, but the generated backgrounds become progressively grayer as the CPS stochasticity increases. In contrast, low-stochasticity CPS and deterministic ODE sampling largely preserve the target white background. The drop therefore reflects a sampler-dependent degradation in visual fidelity rather than a complete failure of the underlying reasoning capability.

Figure 17在 CPS 下跨训练检查点进一步追踪这种故障模式further traces this failure mode across training checkpoints under CPS withη=0.9\eta=0.9。背景颜色偏差在步骤400开始出现，在步骤500最严重，并在步骤600基本恢复，与评估性能的暂时下降紧密匹配。. The background-color deviation begins to emerge at Step 400, is most severe at Step 500, and largely recovers by Step 600, closely matching the temporary drop in evaluation performance.

这些观察结果表明，通用 VLM 判断并不能可靠地惩罚细微的背景颜色偏差。因此，即使前台任务正确完成，此类错误也会在优化期间持续存在，并在更加随机的采样下变得放大。相比之下，基于任务的可验证评分器明确捕获这些偏差并提供更稳定的优化信号。这解释了为什么尽管使用相同的底层策略优化过程，但增加随机性对 VLM-Judge RL 的益处不如 Verulated-RL 一致。These observations suggest that the general-purpose VLM judge does not reliably penalize subtle background-color deviations. Such errors can therefore persist during optimization and become amplified under more stochastic sampling, even when the foreground task is completed correctly. In contrast, the task-grounded verifiable scorer explicitly captures these deviations and provides a more stable optimization signal. This explains why increasing stochasticity benefits VLM-Judge RL less consistently than Verifiable-RL, despite using the same underlying policy optimization procedure.

B.6 有向时间轨迹可视化Directed Temporal Trajectory Visualization

为了总结完整的导航视频而不显示稀疏的帧子集，我们将每个 81 帧视频渲染为阶段式定向中心线轨迹。让To summarize the complete navigation videos without displaying a sparse subset of frames, we render each 81-frame video as a stage-wise directed centerline trajectory. LetItI_{t}表示框架denote framett, 其中, wheret∈{0,…,80}t\in\{0,\ldots,80\}。由于场景布局和任务标记保持静态，因此我们首先通过采用每个像素的时间中值来估计干净的背景。然后我们构建一个软前景掩模. Because the scene layout and task markers remain static, we first estimate a clean background by taking the per-pixel temporal median. We then construct a soft foreground maskMt​(p)∈[0,1]M_{t}(p)\in[0,1]使用移动代理的已知颜色——迷宫任务中为绿色，航路点任务中为橙色。using the known color of the moving agent—green in the maze task and orange in the waypoint task.

为了从每一帧中恢复单个代理位置，我们对软掩模进行阈值处理，保留其最大的连接分量To recover a single agent location from each frame, we threshold the soft mask, retain its largest connected component𝒞t\mathcal{C}_{t}，并使用分量质心：, and use the component centroid:

B⁡(p)=mediantIt​(p),p^t=1|𝒞t|​∑p∈𝒞tp.B(p)=\operatorname*{median}_{t}I_{t}(p),\qquad\widehat{p}_{t}=\frac{1}{\lvert\mathcal{C}_{t}\rvert}\sum_{p\in\mathcal{C}_{t}}p. (2)

仅保留最大的组件可以抑制静态任务标记中的小压缩伪影和残留颜色。当相邻位置足够接近时，我们线性插值孤立的单帧检测失败。较长的消失和较大的帧间跳跃仍保持断开状态，因此无法人为修复前 RL 视频中的突然重定位等故障。Keeping only the largest component suppresses small compression artifacts and residual colors from the static task markers. We linearly interpolate isolated single-frame detection failures when the neighboring locations are sufficiently close. Longer disappearances and large inter-frame jumps remain disconnected, so failures such as abrupt relocation in the pre-RL video are not artificially repaired.

我们在智能体到达特定任务中间目标的帧处划分每个 RLVR 轨迹，并将相同的时间边界应用于相应的预 RL 视频以进行直接比较。对于We divide each RLVR trajectory at the frames where the agent reaches the task-specific intermediate targets and apply the same temporal boundaries to the corresponding pre-RL video for direct comparison. ForFigure 21，我们将轨迹分为四个阶段：开始到 1、1 到 2、2 到 3 和 3 到目标。对于, we divide the trajectories into four stages: Start-to-1, 1-to-2, 2-to-3, and 3-to-Goal. ForFigure 13，我们将它们分为三个阶段：开始到红色、红色到青色和青色到目标。每个阶段都分配有不同的颜色，箭头指示运动方向。当两个阶段以相反方向穿过同一空间段时，它们的中心线会稍微偏移，以便两次通过都保持可见。, we divide them into three stages: Start-to-Red, Red-to-Cyan, and Cyan-to-Goal. Each stage is assigned a distinct color, and arrowheads indicate the direction of motion. When two stages traverse the same spatial segment in opposite directions, their centerlines are slightly offset so that both passes remain visible.

最后，我们在中间背景上渲染有向轨迹，并从干净的参考图像中恢复静态任务标记。所有 81 帧都对恢复的轨迹有贡献；不使用时间子采样。直接 RGB 平均会衰减仅占据每个位置几帧的移动对象，与此相比，基于前景的中心线保留了其运动。与时间前景联合相比，阶段式表示还暴露了遍历方向、重复访问和不连续性。Finally, we render the directed trajectories over the median background and restore the static task markers from a clean reference image. All 81 frames contribute to the recovered trajectories; no temporal subsampling is used. Compared with direct RGB averaging, which attenuates a moving object that occupies each location for only a few frames, the foreground-based centerline preserves its motion. Compared with a temporal foreground union, the stage-wise representation additionally exposes traversal direction, repeated visits, and discontinuities.

B.7 其他定性示例Additional Qualitative Examples

我们提供了更多示例来说明可验证强化学习如何改变模型的推理轨迹。前三个示例比较了不同降噪步骤的预测，而最后一个示例则检查生成的行为如何在视频帧中演变。我们使用We provide additional examples to illustrate how Verifiable-RL changes the model’s reasoning trajectory. The first three examples compare predictions at different denoising steps, while the final example examines how the generated behavior evolves across video frames. We use前强化学习pre-RL表示训练可验证强化学习的 SFT 初始化策略。to denote the SFT-initialized policy from which Verifiable-RL is trained.

Figure 18表明可验证强化学习更有能力修改中间决策。一旦预强化学习模型开始标记三角形，其预测就保持不变。可验证强化学习最初也考虑三角形，但随后将其预测重定向到正确的五边形。由于两个模型都使用相同的 30 步采样计划，因此这种差异反映了去噪轨迹的更有效使用，而不是额外的推理计算。shows that Verifiable-RL is more capable of revising an intermediate decision. Once the pre-RL model begins marking the triangle, its prediction remains unchanged. Verifiable-RL also considers the triangle initially, but subsequently redirects its prediction toward the correct pentagon. Since both models use the same 30-step sampling schedule, this difference reflects more effective use of the denoising trajectory rather than additional inference computation.

中的示例The examples inFigures 19和and20涉及不同的任务，但表现出相似的进展。在集合交集任务中，模型必须识别正确的区域。可验证强化学习逐渐减少对预期重叠的广泛预测，而预强化学习模型仍然专注于不相关的边界。在对象匹配任务中，模型必须确定应连接哪些对象。可验证强化学习逐渐用两个正确的配对取代不确定或不一致的连接。因此，一个示例涉及找到正确的区域，另一个示例涉及连接正确的对象，但这两个示例都显示了强化学习之后向任务一致解决方案的更有序的过渡。involve different tasks but exhibit a similar progression. In the set-intersection task, the model must identify the correct region. Verifiable-RL progressively reduces a broad predi ction to the intended overlap, while the pre-RL model remains focused on irrelevant boundaries. In the object-matching task, the model must determine which objects should be connected. Verifiable-RL gradually replaces uncertain or inconsistent connections with the two correct pairings. Thus, one example concerns finding the correct region and the other concerns connecting the correct objects, but both show a more orderly transition toward a task-consistent solution after RL.

前面的示例比较了去噪步骤的预测，而The preceding examples compare predictions across denoising steps, whereasFigure 21检查最终视频的时间演变。 pre-RL 模型将智能体放置在不一致的位置，并且无法维持中间目标的连贯序列。可验证强化学习会产生更连续的状态转换并最终到达目的地。这表明强化学习不仅改进了去噪过程​​中解决方案的细化方式，而且还改进了多阶段行为随着时间的推移执行的方式。examines the temporal evolution of the final video. The pre-RL model places the agent at inconsistent locations and fails to maintain a coherent sequence of intermediate goals. Verifiable-RL produces more continuous state transitions and eventually reaches the destination. This suggests that RL improves not only how a solution is refined during denoising, but also how a multi-stage behavior is executed over time.

总的来说，这些例子表明，可验证强化学习改进了视觉推理轨迹的两个方面：中间预测变得更有效地针对任务一致的结果进行细化，并且最终的行为在视频帧之间变得更加连贯。Overall, these examples show that Verifiable-RL improves two aspects of the visual reasoning trajectory: intermediate predictions become more effectively refined toward task-consistent outcomes, and the resulting behavior becomes more coherent across video frames.

附录CAppendix CVBVR-Pro-数据集的其他详细信息和分析Additional Details and Analysis of the VBVR-Pro-Dataset

C.1 多模态设计的其他示例Additional Examples of the Multi-modality Design

VBVR-Pro 中的每个实例都以视频和图像两种方式发布，它们是同一已解决实例的两个渲染，而不是两个独立收集的语料库。本附录描述了如何从已解决的实例中导出图像模态，并提供了中介绍的三种输出机制的附加示例。Every instance in VBVR-Pro is released in two modalities, video and image, which are two renderings of the same solved instance rather than two independently collected corpora. This appendix describes how the image modality is derived from a solved instance and provides additional examples of the three output regimes introduced inSection 2.2. Figure 22显示每个政权的多项任务。shows multiple tasks from each regime.

输出机制的选择。Choice of output regime.

该机制是任务生成器的属性，因此任务的所有实例共享相同的机制。它取决于必须明确多少解轨迹才能指定答案。The regime is a property of the task generator, so all instances of a task share the same regime. It is determined by how much of the solution trajectory has to be made explicit in order to specify the answer.最后一帧Last-Frame当解决方案完全由其最终状态决定并且没有中间状态携带模型必须产生的信息时使用；该任务只有一个输出图像，就像完成数独网格或将获胜棋子放入五子棋中一样。is used when the solution is fully determined by its final state and no intermediate state carries information the model must produce; the task then has exactly one output image, as in completing a Sudoku grid or placing the winning stone in Gomoku.关键帧Key-Frame当解决方案由语义上有意义的离散步骤组成时，其中间状态构成答案的一部分，例如滑块拼图中每次移动一个棋盘状态或每个插入的书一个书架状态。因此，输出图像的数量通常取决于实例，遵循该实例解决方案中的步骤数。基于路径的任务（例如迷宫）被视为特殊情况：完整的解决方案路径覆盖在选定的帧上，从而允许在单个图像中表示轨迹。is used when the solution consists of semantically meaningful discrete steps whose intermediate states form part of the answer, such as one board state per move in a sliding-block puzzle or one shelf state per inserted book. The number of output images is therefore generally instance-dependent, following the number of steps in that instance’s solution. Path-based tasks, such as mazes, are treated as a special case: the complete solution path is overlaid on a selected frame, allowing the trajectory to be represented in a single image.多帧Multi-Frame用于没有自然离散分解的连续过程，例如将对象旋转和平移为目标姿势。在这种情况下，中间状态沿着特定于任务的过程参数以统一的进度进行采样。is used for continuous processes that have no natural discrete decomposition, such as rotating and translating an object to a target pose. In this regime, intermediate states are sampled at uniform progress along a task-specific process parameter.

图片提示。Image prompts.

视频和图像模式共享相同的任务描述。图像提示附加了明确的输出规范，说明要生成多少图像以及每个图像应描绘什么，如中粗体所示The video and image modalities share the same task description. The image prompt appends an explicit output specification stating how many images to produce and what each should depict, as shown in bold inFigure 22。视频提示省略了这一规范，因为视频连续地代表了该过程。这使得任务条件在不同模态中保持相同，同时使图像模态使用的离散化对模型来说是明确的。. The video prompt omits this specification because the video represents the process continuously. This keeps the task conditions identical across modalities while making the discretisation used by the image modality explicit to the model.

任务分配。Distribution over tasks.

在 VBVR-Pro 的 300 个任务中，209 个 (69.7%) 使用最后帧机制，58 个 (19.3%) 使用关键帧，33 个 (11.0%) 使用多帧。最后一帧约占任务的 70%，因为对于许多推理问题，最终状态本身就构成了完整的答案。剩下的百分之三十需要明确表示中间解决方案状态，从而为研究更广泛的问题提供受控设置：动态视频或离散图像序列是否为视觉推理提供更有效的表示。Of the 300 tasks in VBVR-Pro, 209 (69.7%) use the Last-Frame regime, 58 (19.3%) use Key-Frame, and 33 (11.0%) use Multi-Frame. Last-Frame accounts for approximately seventy percent of the tasks because, for many reasoning problems, the final state alone constitutes a complete answer. The remaining thirty percent require intermediate solution states to be represented explicitly, and thus provide a controlled setting for studying a broader question: whether dynamic video or discretized image sequences offer a more effective representation for visual reasoning.

C.2 交错数据生成Interleaved Data Generation

交错表示将每个输出图像与紧邻其前面的文本推理步骤配对。图像直接取自中描述的图像模态The interleaved representation pairs each output image with a textual reasoning step placed immediately before it. The images are taken directly from the image modality described inSection C.1。一个实例包含. An instance containingKK因此输出图像产生output images therefore producesKK推理-图像对。reasoning-image pairs.

推理文本生成。Reasoning text generation.

对于每个实例，Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 都会接收任务问题、输入图像和求解器生成的输出图像的完整序列，并为每个图像生成一个推理步骤。提供完整的轨迹是因为许多任务很难仅通过输入可靠地解决。因此，Gemini 注释已知的状态转换，而不是独立发现解决方案。每个步骤都按预期措辞并放置在相应图像之前。For each instance, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview receives the task question, input image, and complete sequence of solver-generated output images, and produces one reasoning step per image. The complete trajectory is provided because many tasks are difficult to solve reliably from the input alone. Gemini therefore annotates the known state transitions rather than independently discovering the solution. Each step is phrased prospectively and placed before its corresponding image.

特定于任务的提示。Task-specific prompts.

我们为每项任务手动设计一个提示，指定其规则、图像顺序、所需推理和输出格式。然后，我们检查每个任务生成的五个注释，以验证它们是否与求解器生成的转换一致。特别是，我们检查每个步骤都解释了导致其相应输出图像的决定，而不是仅仅为图像添加标题。作为代表性示例，我们显示了 Klotski 滑动块任务的注释提示，如关键帧行中最左边的示例所示We manually design one prompt for each task, specifying its rules, image order, required reasoning, and output format. We then inspect five generated annotations from each task to verify that they are consistent with the solver-generated transitions. In particular, we check that each step explains the decision leading to its corresponding output image rather than merely captioning the image. As a representative example, we show the annotation prompt for the Klotski sliding-block task, shown as the leftmost example in the Key-Frame row ofFigure 22.

C.3 视觉复杂度测量Visual Complexity Measurements

Section 2.3报告称，新设计的 150 项任务 VBVR-Pro 比 VBVR 重新设计的 150 个任务在视觉上更加丰富。在这里，我们提供了支持这一说法的测量结果。由于图像复杂性没有单一的公认定义，因此我们考虑四种补充措施。我们的结论是基于两组的一致排序，而不是任何单独的衡量标准。reports that the 150 tasks newly designed for VBVR-Pro are visually richer than the 150 tasks reworked from VBVR. Here, we provide the measurements supporting this claim. Because there is no single accepted definition of image complexity, we consider four complementary measures. Our conclusion is based on their consistent ordering of the two groups rather than on any individual measure.

协议。Protocol.

所有测量值均在问题框架上计算（All measurements are computed on the question frame (第一帧.pngfirst_frame.png），作为输入提供给模型。对于这 300 个任务中的每一个，我们在实例列表中均匀分布的位置选择 50 个实例。我们对这些实例中的每个度量进行平均以获得一个任务级别值，为重新设计的任务生成 150 个值，为新设计的任务生成 150 个值。然后我们比较这些任务级别值的分布。这将任务而不是单个实例视为分析单元，并避免将同一任务生成的多个实例视为独立观察。), which is provided to the model as input. For each of the 300 tasks, we select 50 instances at evenly spaced positions in the instance list. We average each measure across these instances to obtain one task-level value, yielding 150 values for the reworked tasks and 150 for the newly designed tasks. We then compare the distributions of these task-level values. This treats the task, rather than the individual instance, as the unit of analysis and avoids regarding multiple instances generated by the same task as independent observations.

措施。Measures.

我们使用四种补充措施，每种措施捕捉视觉复杂性的不同方面：We use four complementary measures, each capturing a different aspect of visual complexity:

  • •

    不同的地区。Distinct regions.我们使用中值剪切量化将每个帧量化为 16 色调色板，无需抖动。对于每个调色板颜色，我们识别 8 个连通分量并保留那些至少占据We quantise each frame to a 16-colour palette using median-cut quantisation without dithering. For each palette colour, we identify 8-connected components and retain those occupying at least10−410^{-4}的框架区域。我们删除最大的连接组件，它对应于渲染中的背景，并计算剩余的组件。这是正文中报告的措施。of the frame area. We remove the largest connected component, which corresponds to the background in our renderings, and count the remaining components. This is the measure reported in the main text.

  • •

    不同的颜色。Distinct colours.我们将每个 RGB 通道量化为 5 位，并计算出至少占据的颜色结果We quantise each RGB channel to five bits and count the resulting colours that occupy at least10−410^{-4}帧像素。of the frame pixels.

  • •

    空间信息（SI）。Spatial information (SI).我们计算亮度平面 Sobel 梯度大小像素的标准偏差，对应于 ITU-T P.910 中定义的帧级 SI 度量We compute the standard deviation over pixels of the Sobel gradient magnitude of the luminance plane, corresponding to the frame-level SI measure defined in ITU-T P.910(itu-p910).

  • •

    编码大小。Encoded size.我们将每个帧重新编码为质量为 90 的 JPEG，并报告生成的文件大小（以千字节为单位）。所有帧都使用相同的编码器和编码设置。We re-encode each frame as JPEG at quality 90 and report the resulting file size in kilobytes. The same encoder and encoding settings are used for all frames.

对于前两个测量，最小面积阈值按帧大小标准化，并且测量以本机渲染分辨率计算。由于 SI 和编码大小对图像分辨率很敏感，因此我们在将每个帧的大小调整为For the first two measures, the minimum area thresholds are normalised by frame size, and the measures are computed at the native rendering resolution. Because SI and encoded size are sensitive to image resolution, we compute both after resizing each frame to512×512512\times 512.

结果。Results.

表Table18报告结果。新设计的任务在所有四项指标下均具有更高的均值和中位数。基于任务级别的中值，它们包含reports the results. The newly designed tasks have higher means and medians under all four measures. Based on the median task-level values, they contain6.9×6.9\times许多不同的地区和as many distinct regions and2.4×2.4\times与重新设计的任务一样多的不同颜色，同时展示as many distinct colours as the reworked tasks, while exhibiting1.7×1.7\times更高的空间信息和higher spatial information and a2.0×2.0\times更大的编码大小。这些补充措施的一致顺序支持这样的结论：新设计的任务在视觉上比重新设计的任务更丰富。larger encoded size. The consistent ordering across these complementary measures supports the conclusion that the newly designed tasks are visually richer than the reworked tasks.

C.4 推理深度：盲法成对判断Reasoning Depth: Blinded Pairwise Judgement

Section 2.3报道称，VBVR-Pro 的新一半比修改后的一半需要更深入的推理。与视觉复杂性不同，推理深度无法直接从渲染帧中测量。因此，我们通过与人工注释的盲法比较来评估它。我们还进行了每个任务的二进制评估，将直接的单规则应用与多步骤推理区分开来。reports that the new half of VBVR-Pro requires deeper reasoning than the reworked half. Unlike visual complexity, reasoning depth cannot be measured directly from a rendered frame. We therefore assess it through a blinded comparison from human annotation. We additionally conduct a binary per-task assessment that distinguishes direct single-rule application from multi-step reasoning.

协议。Protocol.

150 个重新设计的任务中的每一个都使用固定的随机一对一匹配与 150 个新任务中的一个进行配对。 GPT-5.5仅接收每个任务的起始帧和指令；任务来源和组标签被保留。每对都会被评估两次，两个任务在第一个和第二个槽之间交换。这控制了位置偏好并允许我们测量其大小。Each of the 150 reworked tasks is paired with one of the 150 new tasks using a fixed random one-to-one matching. GPT-5.5 receives only the starting frame and instruction for each task; task origins and group labels are withheld. Each pair is evaluated twice, with the two tasks exchanged between the first and second slots. This controls for positional preference and allows us to measure its magnitude.

对于成对评估，注释者被要求选择需要更多推理的任务，然后才能确定其答案。仅当在两个排序下选择相同的任务时，一对才被视为一致。在单独的每个任务评估中，注释器根据其答案是否来自于将单个规则直接应用于起始框架，或者是否需要多个相关推理步骤（例如比较替代方案、搜索可能性或消除候选答案）对每个任务进行分类。For the pairwise assessment, annotator is asked to select the task that requires more reasoning before its answer can be determined. A pair is counted as consistent only when the same task is selected under both orderings. In a separate per-task assessment, annotator classifies each task according to whether its answer follows from a direct application of a single rule to the starting frame or instead requires multiple dependent inference steps, such as comparing alternatives, searching over possibilities, or eliminating candidate answers.

结果。Results.

第一个位置在 45.8% 的成对判断中被选中，并具有决定性的结果，表明系统性位置偏差很小。这两个排序为 150 对中的 133 对（88.7%）选择了相同的任务。在所有 150 对中，有 113 例（75.3%）在两种排序下选择了新任务，因为在两种排序下都需要更多推理，而在 20 例（13.3%）中，在两种排序下选择了修改后的任务；其余 17 对 (11.3%) 产生了不一致的结果。在每项任务评估中，150 个返工任务中有 10 个（6.7%）被归类为需要多步骤推理，而 150 个新任务中有 70 个（46.7%）被归类为需要多步骤推理。这些结果表明，与重新设计的任务相比，新任务更有可能需要更大的相对推理深度和多个相关推理步骤。The first slot was selected in 45.8% of pairwise judgements with a decisive outcome, indicating little systematic position bias. The two orderings selected the same task for 133 of the 150 pairs (88.7%). Among all 150 pairs, the new task was selected as requiring more reasoning under both orderings in 113 cases (75.3%), whereas the reworked task was selected under both orderings in 20 cases (13.3%); the remaining 17 pairs (11.3%) produced inconsistent outcomes. In the per-task assessment, 10 of the 150 reworked tasks (6.7%) were classified as requiring multi-step reasoning, compared with 70 of the 150 new tasks (46.7%). These results show that the new tasks are more likely to require both greater relative reasoning depth and multiple dependent inference steps than the reworked tasks.

成本估算Cost Estimation

对于专有 API，每次评估的成本是根据代币使用情况和提供商的价格计算的。对于开源评委来说，它是自托管 Lambda H100 SXM 节点上的总挂钟评估时间乘以其租赁价格。我们的评分器是一种轻量级的基于规则的计算，不需要 API 调用，只需要最少的计算（可选用于 OCR 的 GPU）。然而，为了保守估计，我们按照开源评委使用的相同 H100 节点租赁费率对其整个挂钟运行时间进行收费。因此，其报告的成本代表了一个上限。For proprietary APIs, cost per evaluation is computed from token usage and the provider’s price. For open-source judges, it is the total wall-clock evaluation time on a self-hosted Lambda H100 SXM node multiplied by its rental price. Our scorer is a lightweight rule-based computation requiring no API calls and only minimal compute (optionally a GPU for OCR) is required. However, for a conservative estimate, we charge its entire wall-clock runtime at the same H100 node rental rate used for the open-source judges. Its reported cost therefore represents an upper bound.

钥匙门导航（任务 G-45）Key-Door Navigation (Task G-45)

如图As shown in Figure25，有色特工必须从起始单元移动到钥匙单元，然后移动到门单元，且不穿过墙壁。我们使用颜色分割跟踪代理的每帧质心，重建其路径，检测墙壁交叉点，并确定是否访问了关键点。分数将轨迹项乘以两个约束门：, a colored agent must move from its starting cell to the key cell and then to the door cell without crossing walls. We track the agent’s per-frame centroid using color segmentation, reconstruct its path, detect wall crossings, and determine whether the key was visited. The score multiplies a trajectory term by two constraint gates:

S=13​(proximity+continuity+coverage)⏟trajectory⋅(0.4+0.6⋅gwall)⋅(0.4+0.6⋅gkey).S=\underbrace{\tfrac{1}{3}(\text{proximity}+\text{continuity}+\text{coverage})}_{\text{trajectory}}\cdot(0.4+0.6\cdot g_{\text{wall}})\cdot(0.4+0.6\cdot g_{\text{key}}). (9)

Each gate is linearly mapped into[0.4,1][0.4,1]通过via0.4+0.6⋅g0.4+0.6\cdot g，因此违反任一约束都会大幅降低分数；例如，跳过键会将其乘数限制为, so violating either constraint sharply reduces the score; for example, skipping the key caps its multiplier at0.4+0.6⋅0.25=0.550.4+0.6\cdot 0.25=0.55.

滚球（任务 O-32）Rolling Ball (Task O-32)

图Figure26显示了一个球沿着固定的弯曲路径滚向目标的情况。我们检测每一帧中的球并测量球位于路径上的帧的比例。分数通过场景一致性项来控制完成项：shows a ball rolling along a fixed curved path toward a target. We detect the ball in each frame and measure the fraction of frames in which the ball lies on the path. The score gates a completion term by a scene-consistency term:

S=Scomp⋅(0.6+0.4⋅qcons).S=S_{\text{comp}}\cdot(0.6+0.4\cdot q_{\text{cons}}). (10)

完成分数。Completion score.最终位置精度由路径跟踪项控制：Final-position accuracy is gated by a path-following term:

Scomp=qpos⋅(0.2+0.8⋅p),p=qon-path⋅qdir⋅qmid,S_{\text{comp}}=q_{\text{pos}}\cdot(0.2+0.8\cdot p),\qquad p=q_{\text{on\text{-}path}}\cdot q_{\text{dir}}\cdot q_{\text{mid}}, (11)

Because these factors are multiplied, a ball that rarely follows the path receives a lowScompS_{\text{comp}}即使它在目标附近结束。even if it ends near the target.一致性门。Consistency gate. qconsq_{\text{cons}}平均场景和背景保留分数，按一个因子缩放完成分数averages scene- and background-preservation scores, scaling the completion score by a factor in[0.6,1][0.6,1].

高密度液体（任务 G-273）High-Density Liquid (Task G-273)

如图所示As illustrated in Figure27，三个相同的物体落入三个杯子中，其中一个杯子含有较稠密的液体，因此应该使其物体漂浮而不是下沉。我们跟踪每个物体的下降，根据其静止高度将其最终状态分类为漂浮或下沉，并检查液位和背景。分数是最终状态和过程项的加权和：, three identical objects fall into three cups, one of which contains a denser liquid and should therefore cause its object to float rather than sink. We track each object’s descent, classify its final state as floating or sinking based on its resting height, and check the liquid levels and background. The score is a weighted sum of final-state and process terms:

S=0.6⋅Sfinal+0.4⋅Sproc.S=0.6\cdot S_{\text{final}}+0.4\cdot S_{\text{proc}}. (12)

最终状态得分。Final-state score.最终对象位置与场景保留一起评估：The final object positions are evaluated together with scene preservation:

Sfinal=qpos⋅(0.5+0.5⋅qscene),S_{\text{final}}=q_{\text{pos}}\cdot(0.5+0.5\cdot q_{\text{scene}}), (13)

哪里whereqposq_{\text{pos}}奖励每个物体停留在正确的漂浮或下沉高度，并且rewards each object for resting at its correct floating or sinking height, andqsceneq_{\text{scene}}测量杯子、液体和背景是否被保留。measures whether the cups, liquid, and background are preserved.过程分数。Process score.下降必须在物理上保持合理：The descent must remain physically plausible:

将对象移动到目标（任务 O-27）Move Objects to Targets (Task O-27)

如图As shown in Figure28，两个对象必须移动到其相应的目标轮廓。我们跟踪每个物体的轨迹并评估其传输，然后检查两个物体是否同时移动。分数通过同步项控制平均传输质量：, two objects must be moved to their corresponding target outlines. We track each object’s trajectory and evaluate its transport before checking whether the two objects move concurrently. The score gates the mean transport quality by a synchronization term:

Smov=12​∑i=12qtrans(i)⋅qvis(i)⋅qtp(i)⋅qdur(i),S_{\text{mov}}=\tfrac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^{2}q^{(i)}_{\text{trans}}\cdot q^{(i)}_{\text{vis}}\cdot q^{(i)}_{\text{tp}}\cdot q^{(i)}_{\text{dur}}, (16)

哪里whereqtransq_{\text{trans}}结合了路径质量和端点精度，combines path quality and endpoint accuracy,qvisq_{\text{vis}}是成功跟踪对象的帧的分数，is the fraction of frames in which the object is successfully tracked,qtpq_{\text{tp}}惩罚传送，并且penalizes teleportation, andqdurq_{\text{dur}}奖励真实的运动持续时间。rewards a realistic motion duration.同步。Synchronization. qsync=qstart⋅qendq_{\text{sync}}=\sqrt{q_{\text{start}}\cdot q_{\text{end}}}奖励在相似时间开始和完成的两个对象。按顺序移动它们驱动器rewards the two objects for starting and finishing at similar times.
